text.en: measuring length in centimetres; use of abbreviation cm
text.zh: 以厘米为单位量长度；使用缩写 cm

text.en: comparing and ordering lengths in cm
text.zh: 比较和排列以厘米为单位的长度

text.en: measuring and drawing a line segment to the nearest cm
text.zh: 量出和画出线段，精确到最接近的厘米

text.en: measuring: length in metres; mass in kilograms/grams; volume of liquid in litres
text.zh: 量：以米为单位的长度；以千克 / 克为单位的质量；以升为单位的液体容量

text.en: using appropriate units of measurement and their abbreviations m, g, kg, ℓ
text.zh: 使用合适的计量单位及其缩写 m、g、kg、ℓ

text.en: comparing and ordering: lengths; masses; volumes
text.zh: 比较和排列：长度；质量；容量

text.en: measuring: length in kilometres (km); volume of liquid in millilitres (ml)
text.zh: 量：以千米（km）为单位的长度；以毫升（ml）为单位的液体容量

text.en: measuring length/mass/volume (of liquid) in compound units
text.zh: 用复合单位量长度 / 质量 /（液体的）容量

text.en: converting a measurement in compound units to the smaller unit, and vice versa: kilometres and metres; metres and centimetres; kilograms and grams; litres and millilitres (numbers involved should be within easy manipulation)
text.zh: 把用复合单位表示的量化成较小的单位，以及反过来：千米和米；米和厘米；千克和克；升和毫升（所用的数应便于计算）

text.en: notation, representations and place values (tenths, hundredths, thousandths)
text.zh: 小数的记法、表示方法和位值（十分位、百分位、千分位）

text.en: converting a measurement from a smaller unit to a larger unit in decimal form, and vice versa: kilometres and metres; metres and centimetres; kilograms and grams; litres and millilitres
text.zh: 用小数形式把量从较小的单位化成较大的单位，以及反过来：千米和米；米和厘米；千克和克；升和毫升

caption.en: This is a {u:15 cm} school ruler. Line one end of the pencil up with 0. The other end is at 9, so the pencil is {u:9 cm} long.
caption.zh: 这是一把 {u:15 cm} 的学校尺子。铅笔的一端对准 0，另一端对着 9，所以铅笔长 {u:9 cm}。

caption.en: One centimetre is the part between two marks. Count the parts under the pencil: 1, 2, 3 … 9. The 0 mark is where you start, not a part. Count the parts, not the marks.
caption.zh: 1 厘米是两条刻度线中间的一格。数一数铅笔下面有几格：1、2、3……9。0 那条线是起点，不算一格。数格子，不数刻度线。

caption.en: On many rulers, 0 is a little way in from the end. Start at 0: line the eraser up with the 0 mark, not with the edge and not with 1. It is {u:4 cm} long.
caption.zh: 很多尺子的 0 不在最边上，而是往里一点。从 0 量起：橡皮对准 0 这条刻度线，不是对准尺子的边，也不是对准 1。橡皮长 {u:4 cm}。

caption.en: This crayon ends between 6 and 7. It is past halfway, so it is nearer 7. To the nearest centimetre, the crayon is about {u:7 cm} long.
caption.zh: 蜡笔的末端在 6 和 7 之间，已经过了中间，离 7 更近。量到最接近的厘米，蜡笔大约长 {u:7 cm}。

caption.en: To draw a line {u:5 cm} long, put your pencil on 0 and draw along the ruler until you reach 5.
caption.zh: 画一条 {u:5 cm} 长的线：笔尖放在 0，沿着尺子画到 5 停下。

keyFacts.en: Start at 0.
keyFacts.zh: 从 0 量起。

keyFacts.en: One centimetre is the part between two marks. Count the parts, not the marks.
keyFacts.zh: 1 厘米是两条刻度线中间的一格。数格子，不数刻度线。

keyFacts.en: If the end is between two marks, choose the nearer one.
keyFacts.zh: 末端在两条刻度之间，取离它近的那一条。

prompt.en: How long is the pencil?
prompt.zh: 铅笔有多长？

guide.en: The pencil starts at 0. Count the parts under it, or read the number its other end is at.
guide.zh: 铅笔从 0 开始。数一数它下面有几格，或者看另一端对着几。

hints.en: Look at the right end of the pencil.
hints.zh: 看铅笔的右端。

hints.en: Each part between two marks is {u:1 cm}.
hints.zh: 两条刻度线中间的一格是 {u:1 cm}。

hints.en: The right end is at 12.
hints.zh: 右端对着 12。

correct.en: Yes. It starts at 0 and ends at 12: 12 parts, {u:12 cm}.
correct.zh: 对。从 0 开始，到 12 结束：12 格，{u:12 cm}。

say.en: From 0 to 12 there are 13 marks but only 12 parts. Count the parts, not the marks.
say.zh: 从 0 到 12 有 13 条刻度线，却只有 12 格。数格子，不数刻度线。

fallback.en: Not yet. Start at 0 and look at the number under the right end of the pencil.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从 0 量起，看铅笔右端对着的数。

reveal.en: The pencil goes from 0 to 12, so it is {u:12 cm} long.
reveal.zh: 铅笔从 0 到 12，所以长 {u:12 cm}。

prompt.en: How long is the leaf, to the nearest centimetre?
prompt.zh: 量到最接近的厘米，叶子有多长？

guide.en: The tip of the leaf is between two marks. Decide which mark it is nearer to.
guide.zh: 叶尖落在两条刻度线之间。看它离哪一条更近。

hints.en: Find the two marks either side of the tip.
hints.zh: 找出叶尖两边的刻度线。

hints.en: Is the tip past halfway between them?
hints.zh: 叶尖过了两条线的中间吗？

hints.en: The tip is just past 8, nearer 8 than 9.
hints.zh: 叶尖刚过 8，离 8 比离 9 近。

correct.en: Yes. The tip is just past 8, nearer 8 than 9: about {u:8 cm}.
correct.zh: 对。叶尖刚过 8，离 8 比离 9 近：大约 {u:8 cm}。

say.en: The tip has not reached halfway between 8 and 9, so it is nearer 8.
say.zh: 叶尖还没到 8 和 9 的中间，所以离 8 更近。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the two marks either side of the tip and choose the nearer one.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看叶尖两边的两条刻度线，取近的那一条。

reveal.en: The tip is a little past 8 and far from 9. To the nearest centimetre, the leaf is {u:8 cm} long.
reveal.zh: 叶尖只比 8 多一点，离 9 还远。量到最接近的厘米，叶子长 {u:8 cm}。

prompt.en: How long is the crayon, to the nearest centimetre?
prompt.zh: 量到最接近的厘米，蜡笔有多长？

guide.en: Find the two marks beside the end of the crayon. Choose the one nearer to the end.
guide.zh: 找出蜡笔末端两边的刻度线，取离末端近的那一条。

hints.en: Look at the right end of the crayon.
hints.zh: 看蜡笔的右端。

hints.en: The end is between 5 and 6. Is it past halfway?
hints.zh: 末端在 5 和 6 之间。它过了中间吗？

hints.en: The end is nearer 6 than 5.
hints.zh: 末端离 6 比离 5 近。

correct.en: Yes. The end is past halfway between 5 and 6, so the crayon is about {u:6 cm} long.
correct.zh: 对。末端过了 5 和 6 的中间，所以蜡笔大约长 {u:6 cm}。

say.en: The end is past halfway between 5 and 6. Look at how close it is to 6.
say.zh: 末端过了 5 和 6 的中间。看看它离 6 有多近。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the two marks beside the end and choose the nearer one.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看末端两边的刻度线，取近的那一条。

reveal.en: The crayon starts at 0 and ends nearer 6 than 5. To the nearest centimetre, it is {u:6 cm} long.
reveal.zh: 蜡笔从 0 开始，末端离 6 比离 5 近。量到最接近的厘米，长 {u:6 cm}。

prompt.en: How long is the eraser, to the nearest centimetre?
prompt.zh: 量到最接近的厘米，橡皮有多长？

guide.en: The eraser starts at 0. Look at which whole-centimetre mark its other end is nearer to.
guide.zh: 橡皮从 0 开始。看另一端离哪条整厘米刻度线更近。

hints.en: Find the right end of the eraser.
hints.zh: 找出橡皮的右端。

hints.en: Compare its distance from 3 with its distance from 4.
hints.zh: 比一比末端到 3 和到 4 的距离。

hints.en: The end is only a little past 3.
hints.zh: 末端只比 3 多一点。

correct.en: Yes. The end is just past 3 and nearer 3 than 4, so the eraser is about {u:3 cm} long.
correct.zh: 对。末端刚过 3，离 3 比离 4 近，所以橡皮大约长 {u:3 cm}。

say.en: The end has not reached halfway between 3 and 4. Look back at the nearer mark, 3.
say.zh: 末端还没到 3 和 4 的中间。再看看较近的刻度线 3。

fallback.en: Not yet. Choose the mark closest to the right end of the eraser.
fallback.zh: 还没对。取离橡皮右端最近的刻度线。

reveal.en: The eraser starts at 0. Its end is nearer 3 than 4, so its length to the nearest centimetre is {u:3 cm}.
reveal.zh: 橡皮从 0 开始，末端离 3 比离 4 近。量到最接近的厘米，长 {u:3 cm}。

prompt.en: How long is the straw?
prompt.zh: 吸管有多长？

guide.en: Start at 0. Follow the straw to its other end and read the mark there.
guide.zh: 从 0 量起。沿着吸管看另一端对着哪条刻度线。

hints.en: Find 0 a little way in from the ruler’s edge.
hints.zh: 找到尺子边往里一点的 0 刻度。

hints.en: Each small part stands for {u:1 cm}. Count the parts, not the marks.
hints.zh: 每一小格表示 {u:1 cm}。数格子，不数刻度线。

hints.en: The right end lines up with 11.
hints.zh: 右端对着 11。

correct.en: Yes. The straw starts at 0 and covers 11 parts, so it is {u:11 cm} long.
correct.zh: 对。吸管从 0 开始，盖住 11 格，所以长 {u:11 cm}。

say.en: From 0 to 11 there are 12 marks and 11 parts. Count the parts, not the marks.
say.zh: 从 0 到 11 有 12 条刻度线、11 格。数格子，不数刻度线。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the straw’s start at 0, then look at the mark under its right end.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找到吸管在 0 的起点，再看右端对着的刻度线。

reveal.en: The straw runs from 0 to 11. Each part is {u:1 cm}, so 11 parts make {u:11 cm}.
reveal.zh: 吸管从 0 到 11。每一格是 {u:1 cm}，11 格就是 {u:11 cm}。

prompt.en: Draw a line {u:7 cm} long.
prompt.zh: 画一条 {u:7 cm} 长的线。

guide.en: Start at 0. Draw along the ruler, counting one part for each centimetre.
guide.zh: 从 0 量起。沿着尺子画，每一小格表示 {u:1 cm}。

hints.en: Find the 0 mark where the line begins.
hints.zh: 找到线的起点 0 刻度。

hints.en: Count the parts, not the marks.
hints.zh: 数格子，不数刻度线。

hints.en: The first part ends at 1. Keep going until you have drawn 7 parts.
hints.zh: 第一格在 1 结束。继续画，直到画满 7 格。

correct.en: Yes. Your line runs from 0 to 7 and covers 7 parts, so it is {u:7 cm} long.
correct.zh: 对。你画的线从 0 到 7，盖住 7 格，所以长 {u:7 cm}。

say.en: You have counted the starting mark as a part. From 0 to 6 there are only 6 parts; draw one more part.
say.zh: 你把起点的刻度线也算成了一格。从 0 到 6 只有 6 格，再画一格。

fallback.en: Not yet. Keep the start at 0 and check how many parts your line covers.
fallback.zh: 还没对。起点放在 0，看看你画的线盖住了几格。

reveal.en: Draw from 0 to 7. The line covers 7 parts of {u:1 cm}, making {u:7 cm}.
reveal.zh: 从 0 画到 7。线盖住 7 格，每格 {u:1 cm}，合起来是 {u:7 cm}。

prompt.en: Draw a line {u:11 cm} long.
prompt.zh: 画一条 {u:11 cm} 长的线。

guide.en: Start at 0. Use the centimetre parts to decide where to stop drawing.
guide.zh: 从 0 量起。每一小格表示 {u:1 cm}，数格子来决定画到哪里。

hints.en: Look for the start of the scale.
hints.zh: 找出刻度的起点。

hints.en: Each small part stands for {u:1 cm}.
hints.zh: 每一小格表示 {u:1 cm}。

hints.en: Draw 10 parts from 0, then one more part.
hints.zh: 从 0 画过 10 格，再画一格。

correct.en: Yes. From 0 to 11 there are 11 parts, so your line is {u:11 cm} long.
correct.zh: 对。从 0 到 11 有 11 格，所以你画的线长 {u:11 cm}。

say.en: The 0 mark is the start. A line ending at 10 covers only 10 parts; draw one more part.
say.zh: 0 刻度是起点。画到 10 只盖住 10 格，再画一格。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the parts, not the marks. Check the mark where your line ends.
fallback.zh: 还没对。数格子，不数刻度线。看看线的末端对着哪条刻度线。

reveal.en: The line starts at 0 and ends at 11. It covers 11 parts of {u:1 cm}, so its length is {u:11 cm}.
reveal.zh: 线从 0 开始，到 11 结束。盖住 11 格，每格 {u:1 cm}，所以长 {u:11 cm}。

prompt.en: Which picture shows the pencil lined up correctly for measuring?
prompt.zh: 哪幅图的铅笔摆对了，可以直接读出长度？

guide.en: Look at the left end of each pencil. Find the picture where it lines up with the start of the scale.
guide.zh: 看每支铅笔的左端，找出对准刻度起点的那幅图。

hints.en: Compare where the two pencils begin.
hints.zh: 比一比两支铅笔从哪里开始。

hints.en: The scale starts at the 0 mark.
hints.zh: 刻度从 0 开始。

hints.en: Start at 0.
hints.zh: 从 0 量起。

correct.en: Yes. In picture B, the pencil starts at 0, so the number at its other end gives its length.
correct.zh: 对。图 B 的铅笔从 0 开始，另一端对着的数就是它的长度。

say.en: In picture A, the pencil starts at 1. Reading only the end mark would include an extra part. Find the pencil that starts at 0.
say.zh: 图 A 的铅笔从 1 开始，直接读末端的数会多算一格。找出从 0 开始的铅笔。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the left end of each pencil and find the one at 0.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看每支铅笔的左端，找出对准 0 的那支。

reveal.en: Choose picture B. The pencil starts at 0 and ends at 8, so you can read its length as {u:8 cm}.
reveal.zh: 选图 B。铅笔从 0 开始，到 8 结束，可以直接读出长 {u:8 cm}。

prompt.en: Which straw is about {u:9 cm} long, to the nearest centimetre?
prompt.zh: 量到最接近的厘米，哪根吸管大约长 {u:9 cm}？

guide.en: Each straw starts at 0. Find the one whose other end is nearer 9 than the mark beside it.
guide.zh: 每根吸管都从 0 开始。找出末端离 9 比离旁边刻度线近的那根。

hints.en: Look at the right end of each straw.
hints.zh: 看每根吸管的右端。

hints.en: Decide which whole-centimetre mark each end is nearest to.
hints.zh: 看看每个末端离哪条整厘米刻度线最近。

hints.en: Between 8 and 9, an end past halfway is nearer 9.
hints.zh: 在 8 和 9 之间，末端过了中间就离 9 更近。

correct.en: Yes. Straw B ends between 8 and 9, past halfway, so its length rounds to {u:9 cm}.
correct.zh: 对。吸管 B 的末端在 8 和 9 之间，过了中间，所以量到最接近的厘米是 {u:9 cm}。

say.en: Straw A is nearer 8, and straw C is nearer 10. Look for the end closest to 9.
say.zh: 吸管 A 的末端离 8 更近，吸管 C 的末端离 10 更近。找出末端离 9 最近的那根。

fallback.en: Not yet. Compare each end with the marks on either side and choose the nearer mark.
fallback.zh: 还没对。比一比每个末端到两边刻度线的距离，取近的那条。

reveal.en: Choose straw B. Its end is nearer 9 than 8, so it is about {u:9 cm} long to the nearest centimetre.
reveal.zh: 选吸管 B。它的末端离 9 比离 8 近，所以量到最接近的厘米，大约长 {u:9 cm}。

prompt.en: Where should you place one end of an eraser to measure its length?
prompt.zh: 量橡皮的长度时，应该把一端放在哪里？

guide.en: The ruler’s scale begins at a numbered mark. Use that mark as the start of your measurement.
guide.zh: 尺子的刻度从一条标了数的刻度线开始。用这条线作测量的起点。

hints.en: Look near the left edge of the ruler.
hints.zh: 看尺子左边靠近边缘的地方。

hints.en: Find the number that means no length has been counted yet.
hints.zh: 找出表示还没量过任何一格的数。

hints.en: Start at 0.
hints.zh: 从 0 量起。

correct.en: Yes. The scale starts at 0. When one end is there, the number at the other end gives the length.
correct.zh: 对。刻度从 0 开始。一端对准 0，另一端对着的数就是长度。

say.en: The edge and the 1 mark do not line up with 0. Find the 0 mark so that reading the other end gives the length.
say.zh: 尺子的边和 1 刻度都没有对准 0。找到 0 刻度，另一端对着的数才是长度。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look for the first numbered mark on the ruler.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找出尺子上第一条标了数的刻度线。

reveal.en: Place one end at the 0 mark, a little way in from the edge. Start at 0.
reveal.zh: 把一端放在 0 刻度，离尺子的边往里一点。从 0 量起。

caption.en: Ravi's key does not start at 0. Its left end is at 3 and its right end is at 8.
caption.zh: Ravi 的钥匙不是从 0 开始的：左端在 3，右端在 8。

caption.en: Count the parts the key covers, from 3 to 8: there are 5. Or take away: 8 − 3 = 5. The key is {u:5 cm} long, not {u:8 cm}.
caption.zh: 数钥匙盖住了几格，从 3 到 8：一共 5 格。也可以用减法：8 − 3 = 5。钥匙长 {u:5 cm}，不是 {u:8 cm}。

caption.en: From 3 to 8 there are 6 marks, but only 5 parts between them. Counting the marks gives {u:6 cm}, one too many. Count the parts, not the marks.
caption.zh: 从 3 到 8 有 6 条刻度线，中间却只有 5 格。数刻度线会得到 {u:6 cm}，多了 1。数格子，不数刻度线。

caption.en: Part of this ruler has broken off, so it starts at 4. You can still measure: the ribbon goes from 6 to 13. That is 7 parts, so it is {u:7 cm} long.
caption.zh: 这把尺子断了一截，从 4 开始。照样能量：丝带从 6 到 13，一共 7 格，所以长 {u:7 cm}。

keyFacts.en: Length is the number of parts from one end to the other.
keyFacts.zh: 长度就是从一端到另一端有几格。

keyFacts.en: You can also take away: end − start.
keyFacts.zh: 也可以用减法：末端 − 起点。

keyFacts.en: There is always one more mark than parts.
keyFacts.zh: 刻度线总比格子多 1 条。

prompt.en: How long is the pencil?
prompt.zh: 铅笔有多长？

guide.en: The pencil does not start at 0. Count the parts from one end to the other, or take away.
guide.zh: 铅笔不是从 0 开始的。数一数从一端到另一端有几格，或者用减法。

hints.en: Find the numbers at both ends of the pencil.
hints.zh: 找出铅笔两端对着的数。

hints.en: Take away: end − start.
hints.zh: 用减法：末端 − 起点。

correct.en: Yes. From 2 to 9 there are 7 parts: 9 − 2 = 7, so {u:7 cm}.
correct.zh: 对。从 2 到 9 有 7 格：9 − 2 = 7，所以是 {u:7 cm}。

say.en: The pencil starts at 2, not 0, so 9 is not its length. Take away: 9 − 2.
say.zh: 铅笔从 2 开始，不是从 0，所以 9 不是它的长度。用减法：9 − 2。

say.en: From 2 to 9 there are 8 marks but 7 parts. Count the parts, not the marks.
say.zh: 从 2 到 9 有 8 条刻度线，却只有 7 格。数格子，不数刻度线。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find both ends of the pencil and count the parts between them.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找出铅笔的两端，数中间有几格。

reveal.en: The pencil goes from 2 to 9: 9 − 2 = 7, so it is {u:7 cm} long.
reveal.zh: 铅笔从 2 到 9：9 − 2 = 7，所以长 {u:7 cm}。

prompt.en: Tap each part the ribbon covers, then write its length.
prompt.zh: 点出丝带盖住的每一格，再写出它的长度。

guide.en: Tap the spaces between the marks, from 5 to 12, one by one. Each space is {u:1 cm}.
guide.zh: 从 5 到 12，把刻度线中间的空格一格一格点出来。每一格是 {u:1 cm}。

hints.en: Start with the part just after 5.
hints.zh: 从 5 后面的那一格点起。

hints.en: Stop at the part that ends at 12.
hints.zh: 点到在 12 结束的那一格为止。

correct.en: Yes. 7 parts from 5 to 12: the ribbon is {u:7 cm} long.
correct.zh: 对。从 5 到 12 有 7 格：丝带长 {u:7 cm}。

say.en: There are 8 marks from 5 to 12, but only 7 parts. Write the number of parts you tapped.
say.zh: 从 5 到 12 有 8 条刻度线，却只有 7 格。写你点出的格数。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the parts you tapped, not the marks.
fallback.zh: 还没对。数你点出的格子，不数刻度线。

reveal.en: From 5 to 12 there are 7 parts: 12 − 5 = 7, so the ribbon is {u:7 cm} long.

prompt.en: How long is the crayon?
prompt.zh: 蜡笔有多长？

guide.en: Find the two numbers at the ends. Count the parts between them, or take away.
guide.zh: 找出两端对着的数。数中间有几格，或者用减法。

hints.en: Find the mark at each end of the crayon.
hints.zh: 找出蜡笔两端对着的刻度。

hints.en: Take away: end − start.
hints.zh: 用减法：末端 − 起点。

correct.en: Yes. 7 − 3 = 4: the crayon covers 4 parts, so it is {u:4 cm} long.
correct.zh: 对。7 − 3 = 4：蜡笔盖住 4 格，所以长 {u:4 cm}。

say.en: 7 is the end number. The crayon starts at 3, so take away 3 from 7.
say.zh: 7 是末端的数。蜡笔从 3 开始，要用 7 减去 3。

say.en: From 3 to 7 there are 5 marks but 4 parts. Count the parts, not the marks.
say.zh: 从 3 到 7 有 5 条刻度线，却只有 4 格。数格子，不数刻度线。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find both ends of the crayon and count the parts between them.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找出蜡笔的两端，数中间有几格。

reveal.en: The crayon goes from 3 to 7. 7 − 3 = 4, so its length is {u:4 cm}.
reveal.zh: 蜡笔从 3 到 7。7 − 3 = 4，所以长 {u:4 cm}。

prompt.en: How long is the leaf?
prompt.zh: 叶子有多长？

guide.en: Look at where the leaf starts and ends. Its length is the distance between those marks.
guide.zh: 看看叶子从哪里开始，到哪里结束。长度就是这两条刻度线之间的距离。

hints.en: Find the mark at each end of the leaf.
hints.zh: 找出叶子两端对着的刻度。

hints.en: Take away: end − start.
hints.zh: 用减法：末端 − 起点。

correct.en: Yes. 11 − 8 = 3: the leaf covers 3 parts, so it is {u:3 cm} long.
correct.zh: 对。11 − 8 = 3：叶子盖住 3 格，所以长 {u:3 cm}。

say.en: 11 is the end number. The leaf starts at 8, so take away 8 from 11.
say.zh: 11 是末端的数。叶子从 8 开始，要用 11 减去 8。

say.en: From 8 to 11 there are 4 marks but 3 parts. Count the parts, not the marks.
say.zh: 从 8 到 11 有 4 条刻度线，却只有 3 格。数格子，不数刻度线。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find both ends of the leaf and count the parts between them.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找出叶子的两端，数中间有几格。

reveal.en: The leaf goes from 8 to 11. 11 − 8 = 3, so its length is {u:3 cm}.

prompt.en: How long is the straw?
prompt.zh: 吸管有多长？

guide.en: Each small part stands for {u:1 cm}. Count the parts the straw covers from one end to the other.
guide.zh: 每一小格表示 {u:1 cm}。从吸管的一端数到另一端，看它盖住几格。

hints.en: Find the mark at each end of the straw.
hints.zh: 找出吸管两端对着的刻度。

hints.en: Take away: end − start.
hints.zh: 用减法：末端 − 起点。

correct.en: Yes. 15 − 4 = 11: the straw covers 11 parts, so it is {u:11 cm} long.
correct.zh: 对。15 − 4 = 11：吸管盖住 11 格，所以长 {u:11 cm}。

say.en: 15 is the end number. The straw starts at 4, so take away 4 from 15.
say.zh: 15 是末端的数。吸管从 4 开始，要用 15 减去 4。

say.en: From 4 to 15 there are 12 marks but 11 parts. Count the parts, not the marks.
say.zh: 从 4 到 15 有 12 条刻度线，却只有 11 格。数格子，不数刻度线。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find both ends of the straw and count the parts between them.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找出吸管的两端，数中间有几格。

reveal.en: The straw goes from 4 to 15. 15 − 4 = 11, so its length is {u:11 cm}.

prompt.en: How long is the string?
prompt.zh: 绳子有多长？

guide.en: The string starts after 0. Take away its start number from its end number to find its length.
guide.zh: 绳子不是从 0 开始的。用末端的数减去起点的数，求出长度。

hints.en: Find the mark at each end of the string.
hints.zh: 找出绳子两端对着的刻度。

hints.en: Take away: end − start.
hints.zh: 用减法：末端 − 起点。

correct.en: Yes. 25 − 10 = 15: the string covers 15 parts, so it is {u:15 cm} long.

say.en: 25 is the end number. The string starts at 10, so take away 10 from 25.
say.zh: 25 是末端的数。绳子从 10 开始，要用 25 减去 10。

say.en: From 10 to 25 there are 16 marks but 15 parts. Count the parts, not the marks.
say.zh: 从 10 到 25 有 16 条刻度线，却只有 15 格。数格子，不数刻度线。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find both ends of the string and count the parts between them.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找出绳子的两端，数中间有几格。

reveal.en: The string goes from 10 to 25. 25 − 10 = 15, so its length is {u:15 cm}.

prompt.en: How long is the pencil?
prompt.zh: 铅笔有多长？

guide.en: The ruler is broken. Find both ends of the pencil, then take away the start number from the end number.
guide.zh: 尺子断了一截。找出铅笔两端对着的数，再用末端的数减去起点的数。

hints.en: Find the mark at each end of the pencil.
hints.zh: 找出铅笔两端对着的刻度。

hints.en: Take away: end − start.
hints.zh: 用减法：末端 − 起点。

correct.en: Yes. 14 − 5 = 9: the pencil covers 9 parts, so it is {u:9 cm} long.
correct.zh: 对。14 − 5 = 9：铅笔盖住 9 格，所以长 {u:9 cm}。

say.en: 14 is the end number. The pencil starts at 5, so take away 5 from 14.
say.zh: 14 是末端的数。铅笔从 5 开始，要用 14 减去 5。

say.en: From 5 to 14 there are 10 marks but 9 parts. Count the parts, not the marks.
say.zh: 从 5 到 14 有 10 条刻度线，却只有 9 格。数格子，不数刻度线。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find both ends of the pencil and count the parts between them.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找出铅笔的两端，数中间有几格。

reveal.en: The pencil goes from 5 to 14. 14 − 5 = 9, so its length is {u:9 cm}.

prompt.en: How long is the eraser?
prompt.zh: 橡皮有多长？

guide.en: The ruler is broken. Find both ends of the eraser, then take away the start number from the end number.
guide.zh: 尺子断了一截。找出橡皮两端对着的数，再用末端的数减去起点的数。

hints.en: Find the mark at each end of the eraser.
hints.zh: 找出橡皮两端对着的刻度。

hints.en: Take away: end − start.
hints.zh: 用减法：末端 − 起点。

correct.en: Yes. 10 − 8 = 2: the eraser covers 2 parts, so it is {u:2 cm} long.
correct.zh: 对。10 − 8 = 2：橡皮盖住 2 格，所以长 {u:2 cm}。

say.en: 10 is the end number. The eraser starts at 8, so take away 8 from 10.
say.zh: 10 是末端的数。橡皮从 8 开始，要用 10 减去 8。

say.en: From 8 to 10 there are 3 marks but 2 parts. Count the parts, not the marks.
say.zh: 从 8 到 10 有 3 条刻度线，却只有 2 格。数格子，不数刻度线。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find both ends of the eraser and count the parts between them.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找出橡皮的两端，数中间有几格。

reveal.en: The eraser goes from 8 to 10. 10 − 8 = 2, so its length is {u:2 cm}.

prompt.en: Tap each part the key covers, then write its length.
prompt.zh: 点出钥匙盖住的每一格，再写出它的长度。

guide.en: Tap the spaces from one end of the key to the other. Each small part stands for {u:1 cm}.
guide.zh: 从钥匙的一端点到另一端，点的是空格。每一小格表示 {u:1 cm}。

hints.en: The first part starts at 4.
hints.zh: 第一格从 4 开始。

hints.en: Stop at the part that ends at 10. Count the parts, not the marks.
hints.zh: 点到在 10 结束的那一格。数格子，不数刻度线。

correct.en: Yes. 10 − 4 = 6: there are 6 parts, so the key is {u:6 cm} long.
correct.zh: 对。10 − 4 = 6：一共 6 格，所以钥匙长 {u:6 cm}。

say.en: From 4 to 10 there are 7 marks but 6 parts. Count the parts, not the marks.
say.zh: 从 4 到 10 有 7 条刻度线，却只有 6 格。数格子，不数刻度线。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the spaces you tapped between 4 and 10.
fallback.zh: 还没对。数一数你在 4 和 10 之间点出的空格。

reveal.en: The key covers 6 parts from 4 to 10. Each is {u:1 cm}, so the key is {u:6 cm} long.
reveal.zh: 钥匙从 4 到 10，盖住 6 格。每格是 {u:1 cm}，所以钥匙长 {u:6 cm}。

prompt.en: Wei Jie says a ribbon from 6 to 13 is {u:13 cm} long. Which method should he use?
prompt.zh: Wei Jie 说从 6 到 13 的丝带长 {u:13 cm}。他该用哪种方法？

guide.en: Look at both ends of the ribbon. Choose a method that finds the distance between them.
guide.zh: 看看丝带的两端。选一种能求出两端之间距离的方法。

hints.en: The ribbon starts at 6, not 0.
hints.zh: 丝带从 6 开始，不是从 0。

hints.en: The end number tells you where the ribbon stops. Its length is the number of parts it covers.
hints.zh: 末端的数告诉你丝带在哪里结束。长度要看它盖住几格。

hints.en: Use end − start: 13 − 6.
hints.zh: 用末端减起点：13 − 6。

correct.en: Yes. Subtracting the start number gives the parts the ribbon covers: 13 − 6 = 7, so {u:7 cm}.
correct.zh: 对。末端减起点就是丝带盖住的格数：13 − 6 = 7，所以长 {u:7 cm}。

say.en: Reading 13 at the end gives its position. The ribbon starts at 6, so subtract 6 from 13.
say.zh: 读末端的 13 只得到末端的位置。丝带从 6 开始，要用 13 减去 6。

say.en: Counting the marks gives 8, but there are only 7 parts. Count the parts, not the marks.
say.zh: 数刻度线会得到 8，可是中间只有 7 格。数格子，不数刻度线。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the start number as well as the end number. Choose how to find the length.
fallback.zh: 还没对。除了末端的数，也要看起点的数。选出求长度的方法。

reveal.en: Wei Jie read the number at the end. He should subtract the start: 13 − 6 = 7. The ribbon is {u:7 cm} long.
reveal.zh: Wei Jie 读了末端的数。他应该减去起点的数：13 − 6 = 7。丝带长 {u:7 cm}。

text.en: Read the number at the end.
Subtract the start number from the end number.
text.zh: 用末端的数减去起点的数。

caption.en: Not every mark on this measuring tape has a number. The numbers go up in tens, with one short mark halfway between them.
caption.zh: 这条卷尺上，不是每条刻度线都标了数。数一次跳 10，两个数中间只有一条短线。

caption.en: From 30 to 40 there are 2 small parts. 10 shared between 2 parts is 5, so each small part stands for {u:5 cm}, not {u:1 cm}.
caption.zh: 从 30 到 40 有 2 小格。10 平均分成 2 格，每格 5，所以每一小格表示 {u:5 cm}，不是 {u:1 cm}。

caption.en: Start at the numbered mark just before the arrow, 30, and count on one small part of {u:5 cm}. The arrow points to {u:35 cm}.
caption.zh: 从箭头前面那个标了数的刻度 30 开始，往后数一格，每格 {u:5 cm}：箭头指着 {u:35 cm}。

caption.en: Mei Ling's height chart counts in tens, with 4 short marks between the numbers. 4 marks make 5 parts, so each small part stands for {u:2 cm}. Count the parts, not the marks.
caption.zh: Mei Ling 的身高尺一次跳 10，两个数中间有 4 条短线。4 条线分出 5 格，每一小格表示 {u:2 cm}。数格子，不数刻度线。

caption.en: The head board is 4 small parts above 120: 122, 124, 126, 128. Mei Ling is {u:128 cm} tall.
caption.zh: 头顶的木板在 120 上面 4 格：122、124、126、128。Mei Ling 身高 {u:128 cm}。

keyFacts.en: Find two numbered marks next to each other.
keyFacts.zh: 找两个相邻的、标了数的刻度。

keyFacts.en: Their difference ÷ the number of parts = what each small part stands for.
keyFacts.zh: 两数之差 ÷ 格数 = 每一小格表示多少。

keyFacts.en: Count on from the numbered mark just below.
keyFacts.zh: 从下面那个标了数的刻度往上数。

prompt.en: Tap each small part from 40 to 60. What does each small part stand for?
prompt.zh: 点出 40 到 60 之间的每一小格。每一小格表示多少？

guide.en: Count the parts between the two numbers, then share the difference between them.
guide.zh: 先数两个数之间有几格，再把两数之差平均分给这几格。

hints.en: How many parts lie between 40 and 60?
hints.zh: 40 和 60 之间有几格？

hints.en: 60 − 40 = 20. Share 20 between the parts.
hints.zh: 60 − 40 = 20。把 20 平均分给这几格。

correct.en: Yes. 4 parts share 20: each small part stands for {u:5 cm}.
correct.zh: 对。4 格平分 20：每一小格表示 {u:5 cm}。

say.en: You shared 20 between 5, the marks. There are 4 parts between 40 and 60: 20 ÷ 4.
say.zh: 你把 20 分给了 5 条刻度线。40 和 60 之间是 4 格：20 ÷ 4。

say.en: A small part is not always {u:1 cm}. 40 to 60 is 20, shared between 4 parts.
say.zh: 一小格不一定是 {u:1 cm}。40 到 60 是 20，平均分成 4 格。

fallback.en: Not yet. Divide 60 − 40 by the number of parts you tapped.
fallback.zh: 还没对。用 60 − 40 除以你点出的格数。

reveal.en: 60 − 40 = 20, and 20 ÷ 4 = 5. Each small part stands for {u:5 cm}.

prompt.en: How tall is Arjun?
prompt.zh: Arjun 有多高？

guide.en: First find what each small part stands for. Then count on from the number just below the head board.
guide.zh: 先找出每一小格表示多少，再从头顶木板下面那个数往上数。

hints.en: Between 130 and 140 there are 5 small parts.
hints.zh: 130 和 140 之间有 5 小格。

hints.en: 10 ÷ 5 = 2: each small part stands for {u:2 cm}.
hints.zh: 10 ÷ 5 = 2：每一小格表示 {u:2 cm}。

hints.en: Count on from 130: 132, 134, 136.

correct.en: Yes. Each small part is {u:2 cm}, and the board is 3 parts above 130: {u:136 cm}.
correct.zh: 对。每一小格是 {u:2 cm}，木板在 130 上面 3 格：{u:136 cm}。

say.en: Each small part stands for {u:2 cm}, not {u:1 cm}. Count on in twos from 130.
say.zh: 每一小格表示 {u:2 cm}，不是 {u:1 cm}。从 130 起两个两个地数。

say.en: You counted one part too many. The board is 3 parts above 130, not 4.
say.zh: 你多数了一格。木板在 130 上面 3 格，不是 4 格。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find what each small part stands for, then count on from 130.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先找出每一小格表示多少，再从 130 往上数。

reveal.en: 130 + 3 × 2 = 136. Arjun is {u:136 cm} tall.

prompt.en: Tap each small part from 30 to 40. What does each small part stand for?
prompt.zh: 点出 30 到 40 之间的每一小格。每一小格表示多少？

guide.en: Look at the two numbered marks. Count the parts, not the marks. Divide the difference by the number of parts.
guide.zh: 看这两个标了数的刻度。数格子，不数刻度线。用两数之差除以格数。

hints.en: Look at the short mark between 30 and 40.
hints.zh: 看 30 和 40 之间的那条短刻度线。

hints.en: One short mark makes 2 small parts.
hints.zh: 一条短刻度线分出 2 小格。

correct.en: Yes. 10 shared between 2 parts is 5. Each small part stands for {u:5 cm}.
correct.zh: 对。10 平均分成 2 格，每格是 5。每一小格表示 {u:5 cm}。

say.en: You divided by the one short mark. It separates 2 parts, so divide 10 by 2.
say.zh: 你除以了短刻度线的条数 1。一条线分出 2 格，要用 10 除以 2。

say.en: Each small part is not always {u:1 cm}. Look at the 2 parts sharing the gap of 10.
say.zh: 每一小格不一定是 {u:1 cm}。看清楚，两个数相差 10，中间有 2 格。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the spaces from 30 to 40, then divide 10 by that count.
fallback.zh: 还没对。数出 30 到 40 之间的格子，再用 10 除以格数。

reveal.en: 40 − 30 = 10, and 10 ÷ 2 = 5. Each small part stands for {u:5 cm}.

prompt.en: Tap each small part from 120 to 140. What does each small part stand for?
prompt.zh: 点出 120 到 140 之间的每一小格。每一小格表示多少？

guide.en: Find the difference between the two numbers. Share it equally between the small parts.
guide.zh: 先求两数之差，再平均分给中间的小格。

hints.en: Look between the numbered marks 120 and 140.
hints.zh: 看标着 120 和 140 的两条刻度线之间。

hints.en: There is one short mark, making 2 parts.
hints.zh: 中间有一条短刻度线，分出 2 格。

correct.en: Yes. The gap of 20 has 2 parts. Each small part stands for {u:10 cm}.
correct.zh: 对。两数相差 20，中间有 2 格。每一小格表示 {u:10 cm}。

say.en: You used the one short mark as the count. Count the 2 spaces on either side of it.
say.zh: 你数的是中间那一条短刻度线。看它两边，一共有 2 格。

say.en: A part is not always {u:1 cm}. The numbers increase by 20 across just 2 parts.
say.zh: 一小格不一定是 {u:1 cm}。这里只隔了 2 格，两个数就相差 20。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the parts between 120 and 140. Divide their difference by that count.
fallback.zh: 还没对。数出 120 到 140 之间的格数，再用两数之差除以格数。

reveal.en: 140 − 120 = 20, and 20 ÷ 2 = 10. Each small part stands for {u:10 cm}.

prompt.en: Tap each small part from 100 to 200. What does each small part stand for?
prompt.zh: 点出 100 到 200 之间的每一小格。每一小格表示多少？

guide.en: Count the parts, not the marks. Share the difference between the numbers equally between the parts.
guide.zh: 数格子，不数刻度线。把两数之差平均分给这些格子。

hints.en: Look at the 4 short marks between 100 and 200.
hints.zh: 看 100 和 200 之间的 4 条短刻度线。

hints.en: Those 4 short marks make 5 parts.
hints.zh: 这 4 条短刻度线分出 5 格。

correct.en: Yes. 100 shared between 5 parts is 20. Each small part stands for {u:20 cm}.
correct.zh: 对。100 平均分成 5 格，每格是 20。每一小格表示 {u:20 cm}。

say.en: You divided 100 by the 4 short marks. They make 5 parts, so use 100 ÷ 5.
say.zh: 你用 100 除以了 4 条短刻度线。它们分出 5 格，要算 100 ÷ 5。

say.en: Each small part is not always {u:1 cm}. A gap of 100 is shared between 5 parts here.
say.zh: 每一小格不一定是 {u:1 cm}。这里两数相差 100，中间有 5 格。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the spaces between the marks. How many share the gap of 100?
fallback.zh: 还没对。看刻度线之间的格子。两数相差 100，中间有几格？

reveal.en: 200 − 100 = 100, and 100 ÷ 5 = 20. Each small part stands for {u:20 cm}.

prompt.en: What reading does the arrow show on Arjun’s tape?
prompt.zh: Arjun 的卷尺上，箭头指着多少？

guide.en: Find what each small part stands for. Count on from the numbered mark just before the arrow.
guide.zh: 先找出每一小格表示多少，再从箭头前面那个标了数的刻度往后数。

hints.en: Look at the parts from 60 to 80.
hints.zh: 看 60 到 80 之间的小格。

hints.en: 20 ÷ 4 = 5. Each small part stands for {u:5 cm}.
hints.zh: 20 ÷ 4 = 5。每一小格表示 {u:5 cm}。

hints.en: The arrow is 3 small parts after 60. Count on in fives.
hints.zh: 箭头在 60 后面 3 小格。从 60 起五个五个地数。

correct.en: Yes. The arrow is 3 parts of {u:5 cm} after 60: {u:75 cm}.
correct.zh: 对。箭头在 60 后面 3 格，每格 {u:5 cm}，读数是 {u:75 cm}。

say.en: You added 1 for each part. Each small part stands for {u:5 cm}; count on in fives from 60.
say.zh: 你每格只加了 1。每一小格表示 {u:5 cm}，要从 60 起五个五个地数。

say.en: You counted one part too many. There are 3 parts from 60 to the arrow. Count the parts, not the marks.
say.zh: 你多数了一格。从 60 到箭头有 3 格。数格子，不数刻度线。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the value of a small part, then count the parts from 60 to the arrow.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先找出每一小格表示多少，再数 60 到箭头之间的格子。

prompt.en: How tall is Ravi on this height chart?
prompt.zh: 这把身高尺显示 Ravi 有多高？

guide.en: Use two numbered marks to find the value of a small part. Count up from the numbered mark below the board.
guide.zh: 先用两个标了数的刻度找出每格表示多少，再从木板下面那个数往上数。

hints.en: Find 100 and 150 on the chart.
hints.zh: 找出身高尺上的 100 和 150。

hints.en: 50 ÷ 5 = 10. Each small part stands for {u:10 cm}.
The board is 3 small parts above 100. Count up in tens.
hints.zh: 木板在 100 上面 3 小格。从 100 起十个十个地数。

correct.en: Yes. The board is 3 parts of {u:10 cm} above 100. Ravi is {u:130 cm} tall.
correct.zh: 对。木板在 100 上面 3 格，每格 {u:10 cm}。Ravi 身高 {u:130 cm}。

say.en: You treated each part as {u:1 cm}. There are 5 parts from 100 to 150, so each stands for {u:10 cm}.
say.zh: 你把每格当成了 {u:1 cm}。100 到 150 之间有 5 格，每格表示 {u:10 cm}。

say.en: You counted one extra part. The mark at 100 is the start; count only the 3 spaces above it to the board.
say.zh: 你多数了一格。把 100 的刻度当作起点，只数它到木板之间的 3 格。

fallback.en: Not yet. Check how much each part stands for, then count up from 100 to the board.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先看每一小格表示多少，再从 100 往上数到木板。

prompt.en: What reading does this tape’s arrow show?
prompt.zh: 这条卷尺的箭头指着多少？

guide.en: Find how much each small part stands for between the numbered marks. Count on from the number before the arrow.
guide.zh: 先用两个标了数的刻度找出每格表示多少，再从箭头前面那个数往后数。

hints.en: Look at the gap from 100 to 200.
hints.zh: 看 100 到 200 之间的小格。

hints.en: There are 5 parts. Each small part stands for {u:20 cm}.
hints.zh: 中间有 5 格。每一小格表示 {u:20 cm}。

hints.en: The arrow is 3 parts after 100. Count 120, 140, then the next mark.
hints.zh: 箭头在 100 后面 3 格。数 120、140，再数下一格。

correct.en: Yes. 3 parts of {u:20 cm} after 100 give {u:160 cm}.
correct.zh: 对。从 100 往后数 3 格，每格 {u:20 cm}，得到 {u:160 cm}。

say.en: You added 1 for each part. 100 ÷ 5 = 20, so each small part stands for {u:20 cm}.
say.zh: 你每格只加了 1。100 ÷ 5 = 20，所以每一小格表示 {u:20 cm}。

say.en: You counted 4 parts after 100. The arrow is only 3 parts after 100; count the spaces again.
say.zh: 你从 100 起数了 4 格。箭头在 100 后面 3 格，再数一数中间的格子。

fallback.en: Not yet. Check the 5 parts from 100 to 200, then count only as far as the arrow.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看清 100 到 200 之间的 5 格，再从 100 数到箭头。

prompt.en: Move the arrow to {u:46 cm}.
prompt.zh: 把箭头移到 {u:46 cm}。

guide.en: Find what each small part stands for. Start from the numbered mark just before the target and count on.
guide.zh: 先找出每一小格表示多少，再从目标前面那个标了数的刻度往后数。

hints.en: Look at the 5 parts from 40 to 50.
hints.zh: 看 40 到 50 之间的 5 格。

hints.en: 10 ÷ 5 = 2. Each small part stands for {u:2 cm}.
hints.zh: 10 ÷ 5 = 2。每一小格表示 {u:2 cm}。

hints.en: 46 − 40 = 6. How many parts of 2 make 6?

correct.en: Yes. 46 is 6 after 40, so the arrow moves 3 parts of {u:2 cm} past 40.
correct.zh: 对。46 比 40 多 6，所以箭头在 40 后面 3 格，每格 {u:2 cm}。

say.en: You stopped one part early. Use 40 as the start, then move across 3 spaces. Count the parts, not the marks.
say.zh: 你少移了一格。把 40 当作起点，再移过 3 格。数格子，不数刻度线。

say.en: You moved 6 parts after 40 as if each stood for {u:1 cm}. Each part stands for {u:2 cm}; work out 6 ÷ 2.
say.zh: 你把每格当成了 {u:1 cm}，从 40 移了 6 格。每格表示 {u:2 cm}，要算 6 ÷ 2。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find 40, then check how many parts of {u:2 cm} you need to reach {u:46 cm}.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找到 40，再算要移几个 {u:2 cm} 才到 {u:46 cm}。

reveal.en: 10 ÷ 5 = 2. Move 3 small parts after 40: 42, 44, 46. The arrow belongs at {u:46 cm}.

prompt.en: Move the arrow to {u:85 cm}.
prompt.zh: 把箭头移到 {u:85 cm}。

guide.en: Use the numbered marks to find the value of a small part. Find the numbered mark just before the target.
guide.zh: 用标了数的刻度找出每格表示多少，再找到目标前面那个标了数的刻度。

hints.en: Look at the parts from 80 to 100.
hints.zh: 看 80 到 100 之间的小格。

hints.en: 20 ÷ 4 = 5. Each small part stands for {u:5 cm}.
hints.zh: 20 ÷ 4 = 5。每一小格表示 {u:5 cm}。

hints.en: 85 − 80 = 5. How many small parts do you need after 80?
hints.zh: 85 − 80 = 5。从 80 往后要移几小格？

correct.en: Yes. Each small part stands for {u:5 cm}. One part after 80 is {u:85 cm}.
correct.zh: 对。每一小格表示 {u:5 cm}。80 后面一格就是 {u:85 cm}。

say.en: You counted the starting mark at 80 as a part. Move across the space to the next mark.
say.zh: 你把起点 80 的刻度线数成了一格。要移过一格，到下一条刻度线。

say.en: You moved 5 parts after 80 as if each stood for {u:1 cm}. Each part stands for {u:5 cm}, so you need just one.
say.zh: 你把每格当成了 {u:1 cm}，从 80 移了 5 格。每格表示 {u:5 cm}，只要移一格。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at 80 and the value of one small part. Check the gap from 80 to 85.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找到 80，看每一小格表示多少，再看 80 到 85 相差多少。

reveal.en: 100 − 80 = 20, and 20 ÷ 4 = 5. Move one part after 80 to {u:85 cm}.

caption.en: This is a metre rule. It is {u:100 cm} long: 1 metre. Your {u:15 cm} ruler fits along it 6 times, with {u:10 cm} left over.
caption.zh: 这是一把米尺，长 {u:100 cm}，就是 1 米。你那把 {u:15 cm} 的尺子可以沿着它放 6 次，还剩 {u:10 cm}。

caption.en: Longer things are measured in metres. We write m for metre. The whiteboard in Hui Min's class is {u:3 m} long.
caption.zh: 长的东西用米量，米写作 m。Hui Min 班上的白板长 {u:3 m}。

words.zh: 铅笔 {u:14 cm} · 走廊 {u:30 m}

caption.en: Measure a pencil in centimetres and a school corridor in metres. This corridor is {u:30 m} long. A pencil {u:14 m} long would be longer than a bus.
caption.zh: 铅笔用厘米量，学校的走廊用米量。这条走廊长 {u:30 m}。{u:14 m} 长的铅笔，比一辆巴士还长。

caption.en: Guess before you measure. A classroom door is about {u:2 m} tall. Something as tall as two doors is about {u:4 m}: not {u:4 cm}, and not {u:40 m}.
caption.zh: 量之前先估一估。教室的门大约 {u:2 m} 高。有两扇门那么高的东西大约 {u:4 m}，不是 {u:4 cm}，也不是 {u:40 m}。

keyFacts.en: Use centimetres for short things and metres for long things.
keyFacts.zh: 短的东西用厘米，长的东西用米。

keyFacts.en: Guess first, then measure.
keyFacts.zh: 先估一估，再量。

prompt.en: Kumar measures a garden path with a long tape. Where does the arrow point?
prompt.zh: Kumar 用长卷尺量花园的小路。箭头指着多少？

guide.en: Find what each small part stands for, count on from 10, then choose the unit.
guide.zh: 先找出每一小格表示多少，从 10 往后数，再选单位。

hints.en: From 10 to 20 there are 5 small parts.
hints.zh: 从 10 到 20 有 5 小格。

hints.en: 10 ÷ 5 = 2: each small part stands for {u:2 m}.
hints.zh: 10 ÷ 5 = 2：每一小格表示 {u:2 m}。

hints.en: Count on from 10: 12, 14.

correct.en: Yes. Each small part is {u:2 m}, and the arrow is 2 parts past 10: {u:14 m}.
correct.zh: 对。每一小格是 {u:2 m}，箭头在 10 后面 2 格：{u:14 m}。

say.en: Each small part stands for {u:2 m}, not {u:1 m}. Count on in twos from 10.
say.zh: 每一小格表示 {u:2 m}，不是 {u:1 m}。从 10 起两个两个地数。

say.en: You counted one part too many. The arrow is 2 parts past 10.
say.zh: 你多数了一格。箭头在 10 后面 2 格。

say.en: The number is right, but this tape is marked in metres. A path {u:14 cm} long would be shorter than your ruler.
say.zh: 数对了，可是这条卷尺是以米为单位的。{u:14 cm} 长的小路比你的尺子还短。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find what each small part stands for, then count on from 10.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先找出每一小格表示多少，再从 10 往后数。

reveal.en: Each small part stands for {u:2 m}. 10 + 2 × 2 = 14, so the arrow points to {u:14 m}.
reveal.zh: 每一小格表示 {u:2 m}。10 + 2 × 2 = 14，箭头指着 {u:14 m}。

prompt.en: Which unit would you use to measure the length of a swimming pool?
prompt.zh: 量游泳池有多长，用哪个单位？

guide.en: Think about how long a swimming pool is compared with your ruler and with a metre rule.
guide.zh: 想一想游泳池有多长，和你的尺子、米尺比一比。

hints.en: A swimming pool is much longer than your ruler.
hints.zh: 游泳池比你的尺子长得多。

hints.en: Long things are measured in metres.
hints.zh: 长的东西用米量。

correct.en: Yes. A swimming pool is long, so you measure it in metres.
correct.zh: 对。游泳池很长，所以用米量。

say.en: Centimetres are for short things such as a pencil. A pool is many metres long.
say.zh: 厘米用来量铅笔这样短的东西。游泳池有好多米长。

fallback.en: Not yet. Is a swimming pool a short thing or a long thing?
fallback.zh: 还没对。游泳池是短的东西，还是长的东西？

reveal.en: A swimming pool is long: measure it in metres (m).
reveal.zh: 游泳池很长：用米（m）量。

prompt.en: Hui Min reads a long measuring tape. Where does the arrow point?
prompt.zh: Hui Min 读长卷尺。箭头指着多少？

guide.en: Find two numbered marks next to each other. Work out what each small part stands for, then count on to the arrow.
guide.zh: 找两个相邻的、标了数的刻度。算出每一小格表示多少，再往后数到箭头。

hints.en: Look between 10 and 20. How many small parts are there?
hints.zh: 看 10 和 20 之间，一共有几小格？

hints.en: There are 5 parts. Each small part stands for {u:2 m}.
hints.zh: 一共有 5 格。每一小格表示 {u:2 m}。

hints.en: The arrow is 4 parts past 10. Count on in twos.
hints.zh: 箭头在 10 后面 4 格。两个两个地往后数。

correct.en: Yes. Four parts of {u:2 m} past 10 give {u:18 m}.
correct.zh: 对。从 10 往后数 4 格，每格 {u:2 m}，就是 {u:18 m}。

say.en: You added 1 for each part. Each small part stands for {u:2 m}. Count on in twos from 10.
say.zh: 你把每格当成了 1。每一小格表示 {u:2 m}。从 10 起两个两个地往后数。

say.en: The number matches the arrow, but the tape is marked in metres. Look for m beside the scale.
say.zh: 数和箭头对上了，可是这条卷尺以米为单位。看刻度旁的 m。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the parts between 10 and 20, then check the unit on the tape.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看 10 和 20 之间的格子，再看卷尺上的单位。

reveal.en: There are 5 parts from 10 to 20, so each stands for {u:2 m}. 10 + 4 × 2 = 18. The arrow points to {u:18 m}.

prompt.en: Kumar reads a long tape marked in metres. Where does the arrow point?
prompt.zh: Kumar 读以米为单位的长卷尺。箭头指着多少？

guide.en: Look at the numbered marks on either side of the arrow. Find the size of a small part before you count on.
guide.zh: 看箭头两边标了数的刻度。先找出每一小格表示多少，再往后数。

hints.en: Look at the parts from 30 to 40.
hints.zh: 看 30 到 40 之间的格子。

hints.en: 10 is shared between 2 parts. Each small part stands for {u:5 m}.
hints.zh: 10 平均分成 2 格。每一小格表示 {u:5 m}。

hints.en: The arrow is one small part past 30.
hints.zh: 箭头在 30 后面一小格。

correct.en: Yes. One part of {u:5 m} past 30 is {u:35 m}.
correct.zh: 对。30 后面一格是 {u:5 m}，所以是 {u:35 m}。

say.en: You added 1 for the small part. There are only 2 parts from 30 to 40, so each stands for {u:5 m}. Look at that gap again.
say.zh: 你把这一小格当成了 1。30 到 40 只有 2 格，每格表示 {u:5 m}。再看这段刻度。

say.en: The number matches the arrow, but this tape uses metres. Check the m on the tape.
say.zh: 数和箭头对上了，可是这条卷尺用米作单位。看卷尺上的 m。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find how many parts lie between 30 and 40, then read the tape in metres.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看 30 到 40 之间有几格，再用米读卷尺。

reveal.en: 40 − 30 = 10, and 10 ÷ 2 = 5. Each small part stands for {u:5 m}. 30 + 5 = 35, so the reading is {u:35 m}.

prompt.en: Kumar needs {u:4 m} of rope. Draw a line from 0 to show how much to cut.
prompt.zh: Kumar 需要 {u:4 m} 的绳子。从 0 画线，表示要剪多长。

guide.en: Start at 0. Count the parts along the tape until the line has the length you need.
guide.zh: 从 0 量起。沿着卷尺数格子，把线画到需要的长度。

hints.en: Find 0 on the tape. The line starts there.
hints.zh: 找到卷尺上的 0。线从这里开始。

hints.en: Each small part stands for {u:1 m}. Count the parts, not the marks.
hints.zh: 每一小格表示 {u:1 m}。数格子，不数刻度线。

hints.en: Move the line end 4 parts from 0.
hints.zh: 把线的末端移到 0 后面第 4 格。

correct.en: Yes. The line covers 4 parts of {u:1 m}, so it shows {u:4 m} of rope.
correct.zh: 对。线盖住 4 格，每格 {u:1 m}，表示 {u:4 m} 的绳子。

say.en: You counted the starting mark as a part. Count the parts, not the marks. Look at the spaces from 0 to the line end.
say.zh: 你把起点的刻度线也算成一格了。数格子，不数刻度线。看 0 到线末端之间的格子。

fallback.en: Not yet. Start at 0. Check how many parts your line covers.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从 0 量起。看你的线盖住了几格。

reveal.en: Start at 0 and draw to 4. The line covers 4 parts of {u:1 m}, so cut {u:4 m} of rope.
reveal.zh: 从 0 画到 4，线盖住 4 格，每格 {u:1 m}，所以剪下 {u:4 m} 的绳子。

prompt.en: Hui Min measures the width of a book. Which unit should you use?
prompt.zh: Hui Min 量一本书的宽，用哪个单位？

guide.en: Picture a book beside your school ruler. Decide whether its width is a short length or a long length.
guide.zh: 想一想把书放在学校用的尺子旁边。书的宽是短的长度，还是长的长度？

hints.en: Look across a book from one side to the other.
hints.zh: 看书从一边到另一边有多宽。

hints.en: A book is much less than a metre wide.
hints.zh: 一本书的宽远远不到 {u:1 m}。

correct.en: Yes. A book has a short width, so centimetres are a suitable unit.
correct.zh: 对。书的宽比较短，适合用厘米量。

say.en: Metres suit long lengths. A book is only a short distance across. Compare it with your school ruler.
say.zh: 米适合量长的东西。书从一边到另一边比较短，和学校用的尺子比一比。

fallback.en: Not yet. Picture the book beside your ruler and think about its width.
fallback.zh: 还没对。想一想书放在尺子旁边有多宽。

reveal.en: Use centimetres (cm) for the width of a book. It is a short length you can measure with your ruler.
reveal.zh: 书的宽用厘米（cm）量。这个长度比较短，可以用你的尺子量。

prompt.en: Which unit should you use to measure the height of a door?
prompt.zh: 量一扇门的高，用哪个单位？

guide.en: Picture a door beside you. Think about its height compared with your short school ruler.
guide.zh: 想一想你站在门旁边。门的高和学校用的短尺子比起来怎样？

hints.en: A door is tall enough for you to walk through.
hints.zh: 门够高，你可以从门里走过去。

hints.en: You would need many short rulers to reach the top.
hints.zh: 要把很多把短尺子接起来，才能量到门顶。

correct.en: Yes. A door is tall, so metres are a suitable unit for its height.
correct.zh: 对。门比较高，适合用米量它的高。

say.en: Centimetres suit short lengths such as a book’s width. A door is much taller. Think of a metre rule held upright.
say.zh: 厘米适合量书的宽这样短的长度。门高得多，想一想把米尺竖起来量。

fallback.en: Not yet. Think about how many short rulers would reach from the floor to the top of a door.
fallback.zh: 还没对。想一想从地面到门顶，需要接多少把短尺子。

reveal.en: Use metres (m) for the height of a door. It is a long length compared with your school ruler.
reveal.zh: 门的高用米（m）量。和学校用的尺子比，这个长度比较长。

prompt.en: Kumar measures the length of a school corridor. Which unit should you use?
prompt.zh: Kumar 量学校走廊的长，用哪个单位？

guide.en: Picture walking from one end of a school corridor to the other. Choose a unit that suits a long length.
guide.zh: 想一想从学校走廊的一端走到另一端。选一个适合量长距离的单位。

hints.en: A school corridor takes many steps to walk along.
hints.zh: 走完学校的一条走廊，需要走很多步。

hints.en: Think of a long measuring tape rather than a short school ruler.
hints.zh: 想一想用长卷尺量走廊，而不是用学校的短尺子。

correct.en: Yes. A school corridor is long, so metres are a suitable unit.
correct.zh: 对。学校的走廊很长，适合用米量。

say.en: Centimetres suit short things. A corridor stretches past many doors. Think of measuring its whole length with a long tape.
say.zh: 厘米适合量短的东西。走廊经过很多扇门，想一想用长卷尺量整条走廊。

fallback.en: Not yet. Picture the whole corridor and compare its length with a metre rule.
fallback.zh: 还没对。想一想整条走廊有多长，和米尺比一比。

reveal.en: Use metres (m) for the length of a school corridor. It is much longer than a short ruler.
reveal.zh: 学校走廊的长用米（m）量。它比短尺子长得多。

prompt.en: About how tall is a classroom door?
prompt.zh: 教室的门大约有多高？

guide.en: Picture yourself standing beside a classroom door. Choose a length that would let people walk through.
guide.zh: 想一想你站在教室的门旁边。选一个能让人走过去的高度。

hints.en: A door is taller than a child, but it does not reach several floors up.
hints.zh: 门比小朋友高，但不会有好几层楼那么高。

hints.en: Picture two metre rules, one above the other.
hints.zh: 想一想把两把米尺上下接起来。

correct.en: Yes. About {u:2 m} is a sensible height for a classroom door: tall enough for people to walk through.
correct.zh: 对。教室的门大约 {u:2 m} 高是合理的，人可以从门里走过去。

say.en: {u:20 m} would reach several floors up. Picture a door beside a person and compare their heights.
say.zh: {u:20 m} 有好几层楼那么高。想一想门旁站着一个人，比一比他们的高度。

say.en: {u:2 cm} is only a short gap on your ruler. People need a much taller doorway. Think in metres.
say.zh: {u:2 cm} 只是尺子上很短的一段。人要走过去，门得高得多。用米来想。

fallback.en: Not yet. Compare each choice with the height of a door you walk through.
fallback.zh: 还没对。把每个选项和你平时走过的门比一比。

reveal.en: A classroom door is about {u:2 m} tall. {u:2 cm} is far too short, and {u:20 m} would reach several floors up.
reveal.zh: 教室的门大约 {u:2 m} 高。{u:2 cm} 太矮，{u:20 m} 却有好几层楼那么高。

prompt.en: Hui Min estimates the length of a bus. Which estimate is sensible?
prompt.zh: Hui Min 估计一辆巴士的长。哪个估计合理？

guide.en: Picture a bus with room for many seats. Compare each choice with things you know, such as your ruler and a doorway.
guide.zh: 想一想能放下很多座位的巴士。把每个选项和你熟悉的尺子、门比一比。

hints.en: A bus is much longer than your school ruler.
hints.zh: 巴士比学校用的尺子长得多。

hints.en: A bus can be about as long as six door heights laid end to end.
hints.zh: 把六扇门的高度首尾接起来，大约和一辆巴士一样长。

correct.en: Yes. About {u:12 m} is a sensible estimate for a bus with many seats.
correct.zh: 对。能放下很多座位的巴士，长大约 {u:12 m} 是合理的估计。

say.en: {u:12 cm} fits on a school ruler. A bus must hold people and seats. Think of its length in metres.
say.zh: {u:12 cm} 在学校用的尺子上就能量出来。巴士要坐人、放座位，用米来想它的长。

say.en: {u:60 m} would be about five buses end to end. Picture just one bus and compare again.
say.zh: {u:60 m} 大约有五辆巴士首尾相接那么长。想一想只有一辆巴士，再比一比。

fallback.en: Not yet. Picture the whole bus and think about the space needed for its seats.
fallback.zh: 还没对。想一想整辆巴士，以及座位需要占多长的地方。

reveal.en: A bus can be about {u:12 m} long. {u:12 cm} is shorter than a school ruler, while {u:60 m} is about five such buses end to end.
reveal.zh: 一辆巴士可以长大约 {u:12 m}。{u:12 cm} 比学校用的尺子还短，{u:60 m} 则大约有五辆这样的巴士首尾相接那么长。

caption.en: The beach ball is much bigger, but the pan with the stone goes down. On a balance, the heavier side goes down. Bigger is not always heavier.
caption.zh: 沙滩球大得多，可是放石头的那边沉了下去。天平上，重的一边往下沉。大的不一定重。

caption.en: When the two sides are level, they have the same mass. This pineapple balances a {u:1 kg} weight, so its mass is {u:1 kg}. We write kg for kilogram.
caption.zh: 两边一样高，就是一样重。这个黄梨和 {u:1 kg} 的砝码一样重，它的质量是 {u:1 kg}。千克写作 kg。

caption.en: Grams are for lighter things. We write g for gram. A {u:1 kg} weight balances {u:1000 g}: here {u:500 g}, {u:200 g}, {u:200 g} and {u:100 g}.
caption.zh: 克用来量轻一些的东西，写作 g。{u:1 kg} 的砝码和 {u:1000 g} 一样重：这里是 {u:500 g}、{u:200 g}、{u:200 g} 和 {u:100 g}。

caption.en: To find a mass, put weights on the other pan until the beam is level, then add them up. Farah's bag of flour is {u:750 g}.
caption.zh: 要知道东西有多重，就在另一边放砝码，放到天平平了，再把砝码加起来。Farah 的那袋面粉是 {u:750 g}。

keyFacts.en: On a balance, the heavier side goes down. Level means the same mass.
keyFacts.zh: 天平上，重的一边往下沉；两边平了，就是一样重。

keyFacts.en: Bigger is not always heavier.
keyFacts.zh: 大的不一定重。

prompt.en: Put weights on the right pan until the balance is level.
prompt.zh: 在右边的盘里放砝码，直到天平平了。

guide.en: The papaya side is down, so it is heavier. Add weights until the two sides are level, then the weights tell you its mass.
guide.zh: 放木瓜的一边沉下去了，说明它重。加砝码，加到两边一样高，砝码就告诉你木瓜有多重。

hints.en: Start with the biggest weight that is not too heavy.
hints.zh: 先放不会太重的最大砝码。

hints.en: Try {u:500 g}, then see which side is down.
hints.zh: 先放 {u:500 g}，再看哪一边沉下去。

correct.en: Yes. The beam is level: the papaya is {u:800 g}.
correct.zh: 对。天平平了：木瓜是 {u:800 g}。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the beam: the side that is down is heavier. Add or take off a weight.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看横梁：沉下去的一边重。加一个或拿下一个砝码。

reveal.en: {u:500 g} + {u:200 g} + {u:100 g} balance the papaya: it is {u:800 g}.
reveal.zh: {u:500 g}、{u:200 g}、{u:100 g} 三个砝码和木瓜一样重：木瓜是 {u:800 g}。

prompt.en: Which is heavier, the long beans or the stone?
prompt.zh: 长豆和石头，哪个重？

guide.en: Do not look at how big they are. Look at which pan has gone down.
guide.zh: 不要看它们有多大，看哪个盘沉下去了。

hints.en: Which pan is lower?
hints.zh: 哪个盘更低？

hints.en: On a balance, the heavier side goes down.
hints.zh: 天平上，重的一边往下沉。

correct.en: Yes. The pan with the stone is down, so the stone is heavier, even though it is smaller.
correct.zh: 对。放石头的盘沉下去了，所以石头更重，虽然它更小。

say.en: The beans take up more room, but look at the balance: the stone's side went down.
say.zh: 长豆占的地方大，可是看天平：放石头的那边沉下去了。

say.en: The side that goes up is the lighter one. On a balance, the heavier side goes down.
say.zh: 翘起来的一边是轻的。天平上，重的一边往下沉。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at which pan is lower.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看哪个盘更低。

reveal.en: The stone's pan is down: the stone is heavier. Bigger is not always heavier.
reveal.zh: 放石头的盘沉下去了：石头更重。大的不一定重。

text.en: the long beans, because they are bigger
the long beans, because their pan is higher
text.zh: 长豆，因为它们的盘更高

prompt.en: Which is heavier, the guava or the kangkong?
prompt.zh: 番石榴和空心菜，哪个重？

guide.en: Look at the two pans. The heavier side goes down, whatever the size of the things.
guide.zh: 看两个盘。无论东西大小，重的一边都会往下沉。

hints.en: Find the lower pan.
hints.zh: 找出较低的盘。

hints.en: The pan with the guava is lower.
hints.zh: 放番石榴的盘较低。

correct.en: Yes. The guava is heavier because its pan is lower.
correct.zh: 对。番石榴更重，因为放它的盘更低。

say.en: The kangkong takes up more room, but its pan is higher. Look at the lower pan with the guava.
say.zh: 空心菜占的地方大，可是它的盘更高。看放番石榴的那个较低的盘。

say.en: A higher pan holds the lighter thing. Look at the guava: its pan goes down.
say.zh: 较高的盘里放的是较轻的东西。看番石榴：放它的盘沉下去了。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at which pan has gone down.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看哪个盘沉下去了。

reveal.en: The guava is on the lower pan, so it is heavier than the kangkong. Bigger is not always heavier.
reveal.zh: 番石榴的盘更低，所以它比空心菜重。大的不一定重。

text.en: the kangkong, because it is bigger
the kangkong, because its pan is higher
text.zh: 空心菜，因为它的盘更高

prompt.en: Which is lighter, the stone or the beach ball?
prompt.zh: 石头和沙滩球，哪个轻？

guide.en: Look at the balance. The lower pan holds the heavier thing, so the higher pan holds the lighter thing.
guide.zh: 看天平。较低的盘里放的是较重的东西，较高的盘里放的是较轻的东西。

hints.en: Find the pan that has gone up.
hints.zh: 找出翘起来的盘。

hints.en: The beach ball is on the higher pan.
hints.zh: 沙滩球的盘更高。

correct.en: Yes. The beach ball is lighter because its pan is higher, even though the ball is bigger.
correct.zh: 对。沙滩球虽然更大，但它的盘更高，所以它更轻。

say.en: The stone is smaller, but its pan goes down. Use the balance to compare how heavy they are.
say.zh: 石头较小，可是放它的盘沉下去了。看天平来比轻重。

say.en: The lower pan holds the heavier thing. Look at the higher pan to find the lighter thing.
say.zh: 较低的盘里放的是较重的东西。要找较轻的东西，就看较高的盘。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the higher pan to see which thing is lighter.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找出较高的盘，看看哪个东西更轻。

reveal.en: The stone goes down and the beach ball goes up. The beach ball is lighter.
reveal.zh: 石头的盘沉下去，沙滩球的盘翘起来。沙滩球更轻。

text.en: the stone, because it is smaller
the stone, because its pan is lower

prompt.en: The pans are level. What can you say about the papaya and the mango?
prompt.zh: 两个盘一样高。木瓜和芒果的轻重怎样？

guide.en: Look along the beam. When the pans are level, neither side is heavier.
guide.zh: 沿着横梁看。两个盘一样高，就没有哪边更重。

hints.en: Check whether either pan is lower.
hints.zh: 看有没有哪个盘更低。

hints.en: Level pans mean the things have the same mass.
hints.zh: 两个盘一样高，表示东西一样重。

correct.en: Yes. The pans are level, so the papaya and the mango have the same mass.
correct.zh: 对。两个盘一样高，所以木瓜和芒果一样重。

say.en: The papaya is bigger, but neither pan is lower. Look at the level beam to compare their masses.
say.zh: 木瓜较大，可是没有哪个盘更低。看平着的横梁来比轻重。

say.en: Level pans do tell you about mass: both sides have the same mass. Look at the two pans at the same height.
say.zh: 两个盘一样高就能比轻重：两边一样重。看这两个一样高的盘。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the pans: both are at the same height.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看两个盘：它们一样高。

reveal.en: Neither pan goes down. The balance is level, so the papaya and the mango have the same mass.
reveal.zh: 两个盘都没有往下沉。天平平了，所以木瓜和芒果一样重。

text.en: The papaya is heavier because it is bigger.
You cannot compare them while the pans are level.
text.zh: 两个盘一样高，就不能比轻重。

prompt.en: Put weights on the right pan to balance the bag of beans.
prompt.zh: 在右边的盘里放砝码，让它和这袋豆一样重。

guide.en: Add weights and watch the beam. If the right pan goes down, take off a weight or try a lighter one.
guide.zh: 加砝码，再看横梁。如果右边的盘沉下去，就拿下一个砝码，或换个轻一点的。

hints.en: Watch which pan is lower after each weight.
hints.zh: 每放一个砝码，就看哪边的盘更低。

hints.en: Try {u:200 g}, then add {u:100 g}.
After {u:300 g}, try adding {u:50 g}.
hints.zh: 放了 {u:300 g} 后，试着再加 {u:50 g}。

correct.en: Yes. The pans are level, so the beans have the same mass as the weights: {u:350 g}.
correct.zh: 对。两个盘一样高，所以豆和砝码一样重：{u:350 g}。

fallback.en: Not yet. The lower side is heavier. Add or take off a weight until both pans are level.
fallback.zh: 还没对。较低的一边重。加上或拿下砝码，直到两个盘一样高。

reveal.en: {u:200 g} + {u:100 g} + {u:50 g} = {u:350 g}. These weights balance the bag of beans.
reveal.zh: {u:200 g} + {u:100 g} + {u:50 g} = {u:350 g}。这些砝码和这袋豆一样重。

prompt.en: The balance is level. How heavy is the onion?
prompt.zh: 天平平了。洋葱有多重？

guide.en: The onion has the same mass as all the weights together. Add their masses, then choose the unit.
guide.zh: 洋葱和所有砝码加起来一样重。把砝码的质量相加，再选单位。

hints.en: Read all three weights on the right pan.
hints.zh: 读一读右盘里的三个砝码。

hints.en: Add 500 + 200 first, then add 20.
The weights are marked in grams.
hints.zh: 砝码上标的是克。

correct.en: Yes. The onion balances {u:500 g} + {u:200 g} + {u:20 g}, so it is {u:720 g}.
correct.zh: 对。洋葱和 {u:500 g}、{u:200 g}、{u:20 g} 的砝码一样重，所以是 {u:720 g}。

say.en: The sum is 720, and the weights are in grams. Look at the g on the weights before choosing a unit.
say.zh: 和是 720，砝码用的是克。选单位前，看看砝码上的 g。

fallback.en: Not yet. Add the masses of all three weights and check their unit.
fallback.zh: 还没对。把三个砝码的质量相加，再看单位。

reveal.en: 500 + 200 + 20 = 720. The balance is level, so the onion is {u:720 g}.

prompt.en: The balance is level. How heavy is the watermelon? Write kilograms.
prompt.zh: 天平平了。西瓜有多重？用千克写出来。

guide.en: Add the two weights. Use {u:1000 g} = {u:1 kg} to write the mass in kilograms.
guide.zh: 把两个砝码的质量相加，再用 {u:1000 g} = {u:1 kg}，把质量写成千克。

hints.en: Read the mass on each weight.
hints.zh: 读一读每个砝码的质量。

hints.en: Each {u:1000 g} weight is {u:1 kg}.
hints.zh: 每个 {u:1000 g} 的砝码就是 {u:1 kg}。

hints.en: There are two weights of {u:1 kg}.
hints.zh: 这里有两个 {u:1 kg} 的砝码。

correct.en: Yes. Two weights of {u:1 kg} balance the watermelon, so it is {u:2 kg}.
correct.zh: 对。两个 {u:1 kg} 的砝码和西瓜一样重，所以西瓜是 {u:2 kg}。

say.en: Each weight is {u:1000 g}, which is {u:1 kg}. You counted two kilograms. Check the unit chip.
say.zh: 每个砝码是 {u:1000 g}，也就是 {u:1 kg}。你数到的是两个千克。再看单位。

fallback.en: Not yet. Change each weight to kilograms, then add the two masses.
fallback.zh: 还没对。把每个砝码的质量换成千克，再相加。

reveal.en: {u:1000 g} + {u:1000 g} = {u:2 kg}. The level balance shows that the watermelon is {u:2 kg}.
reveal.zh: {u:1000 g} + {u:1000 g} = {u:2 kg}。天平平了，表示西瓜是 {u:2 kg}。

prompt.en: Choose g or kg to measure the mass of one paper clip.
prompt.zh: 量一个回形针有多重，用 g 还是 kg？

guide.en: Think about holding one paper clip. Use grams for light things and kilograms for heavier loads.
guide.zh: 想一想拿着一个回形针的感觉。轻的东西用克，重一些的东西用千克。

hints.en: Think about how light one paper clip feels.
hints.zh: 想一想一个回形针有多轻。

hints.en: Grams are used for light things.
hints.zh: 轻的东西用克量。

correct.en: Yes. One paper clip is light, so grams are a suitable unit.
correct.zh: 对。一个回形针很轻，用克合适。

say.en: Kilograms are used for heavier loads. Think about one light paper clip and choose grams.
say.zh: 千克用来量重一些的东西。想一想轻轻的一个回形针，选克。

fallback.en: Not yet. Think about how light a paper clip is, then choose the unit.
fallback.zh: 还没对。想一想回形针有多轻，再选单位。

reveal.en: Use g for the mass of one paper clip because it is light.
reveal.zh: 一个回形针很轻，量它有多重用 g。

prompt.en: Choose g or kg to measure the mass of this full bag of rice.
prompt.zh: 量这一整袋米有多重，用 g 还是 kg？

guide.en: Think about lifting a full bag of rice. Choose the unit used for heavier loads.
guide.zh: 想一想提起一整袋米的感觉。选量重一些的东西时用的单位。

hints.en: Compare lifting a full bag of rice with holding one paper clip.
hints.zh: 比一比提起一整袋米和拿着一个回形针的感觉。

hints.en: Kilograms are used for heavier loads.
hints.zh: 重一些的东西用千克量。

correct.en: Yes. Kilograms suit this heavy bag of rice. This bag has a mass of {u:5 kg}.
correct.zh: 对。这袋米比较重，用千克合适。这袋米是 {u:5 kg}。

say.en: Grams suit light things such as one paper clip. Think about lifting this full bag and choose kilograms.
say.zh: 克适合量回形针这样的轻东西。想一想提起这一整袋米的感觉，选千克。

fallback.en: Not yet. Think about lifting the full bag, then choose the unit for a heavier load.
fallback.zh: 还没对。想一想提起这整袋米，选量重一些的东西时用的单位。

reveal.en: Use kg for this bag of rice. Its mass is {u:5 kg}.
reveal.zh: 这袋米用 kg 量。它的质量是 {u:5 kg}。

caption.en: Before you weigh anything, look at the needle. With nothing on the pan, it should point to 0. You can check this at the wet market too.
caption.zh: 称东西以前，先看指针。盘上什么都没有时，指针应该指着 0。在湿巴刹买东西时，也可以这样看一看。

caption.en: A dial is a number line bent into a circle. Straighten it out and you see the same marks and the same numbers: 0, 100, 200 … up to 500.
caption.zh: 秤盘是弯成圆圈的数轴。把它拉直，刻度和数都一样：0、100、200……一直到 500。

caption.en: Between 200 and 300 there are 4 short marks, which make 5 small parts. 100 ÷ 5 = 20, so each small part stands for {u:20 g}, not {u:25 g}.
caption.zh: 200 到 300 之间有 4 条短线，分出 5 小格。100 ÷ 5 = 20，所以每一小格表示 {u:20 g}，不是 {u:25 g}。

caption.en: Siti's prawns: the needle is 4 small parts past 200. Count on in twenties: 220, 240, 260, 280. The prawns are {u:280 g}, not {u:204 g}.
caption.zh: Siti 买的虾：指针在 200 后面 4 格。二十二十地数：220、240、260、280。虾是 {u:280 g}，不是 {u:204 g}。

caption.en: A bigger scale is marked in kilograms. The numbers go up in twos, with one mark between, so each small part stands for {u:1 kg}. The watermelon is {u:3 kg}, not {u:3 g}.
caption.zh: 大一点的秤用千克。数一次跳 2，中间一条短线，所以每一小格表示 {u:1 kg}。西瓜是 {u:3 kg}，不是 {u:3 g}。

keyFacts.en: Check that the needle starts at 0.
keyFacts.zh: 称之前，先看指针是不是指着 0。

keyFacts.en: Find what each small part stands for, then count on from the number just before the needle.
keyFacts.zh: 先找出每一小格表示多少，再从指针前面那个数往后数。

keyFacts.en: Read the unit on the dial: g or kg.
keyFacts.zh: 看清秤上的单位：g 还是 kg。

prompt.en: Wei Jie weighs a fish at the wet market. What is its mass?
prompt.zh: Wei Jie 在湿巴刹称一条鱼。鱼有多重？

guide.en: Find what each small part stands for, count on from the number just before the needle, then choose the unit on the dial.
guide.zh: 先找出每一小格表示多少，从指针前面那个数往后数，再选秤上写的单位。

hints.en: Between 400 and 500 there is one short mark: 2 small parts.
hints.zh: 400 和 500 之间有一条短线：2 小格。

hints.en: 100 ÷ 2 = 50: each small part stands for {u:50 g}.
The needle is 1 part past 400.
hints.zh: 指针在 400 后面 1 格。

correct.en: Yes. Each small part is {u:50 g}, and the needle is one part past 400: {u:450 g}.
correct.zh: 对。每一小格是 {u:50 g}，指针在 400 后面 1 格：{u:450 g}。

say.en: Each small part stands for {u:50 g}, not {u:1 g}. One part past 400 is 450.
say.zh: 每一小格表示 {u:50 g}，不是 {u:1 g}。400 后面 1 格是 450。

say.en: You went one part too far. The needle is 1 part past 400, not 2.
say.zh: 你多走了一格。指针在 400 后面 1 格，不是 2 格。

say.en: The dial is marked in grams. A fish of {u:450 kg} would be heavier than five grown-ups.
say.zh: 秤上写的是克。{u:450 kg} 的鱼比五个大人还重。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find what each small part stands for, then count on from 400.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先找出每一小格表示多少，再从 400 往后数。

reveal.en: Each small part is {u:50 g}. 400 + 50 = 450: the fish is {u:450 g}.

prompt.en: Tap each small part from 100 to 200. What does each small part stand for?
prompt.zh: 点出 100 到 200 之间的每一小格。每一小格表示多少？

guide.en: Tap the spaces, not the marks. Then share 100 between the parts you tapped.
guide.zh: 点的是空格，不是刻度线。再把 100 平均分给你点出的格子。

hints.en: There are 4 short marks between 100 and 200.
hints.zh: 100 和 200 之间有 4 条短线。

hints.en: 4 marks make 5 parts.
hints.zh: 4 条线分出 5 格。

correct.en: Yes. 5 parts share 100: each small part stands for {u:20 g}.
correct.zh: 对。5 格平分 100：每一小格表示 {u:20 g}。

say.en: You shared 100 between the 4 short marks. They make 5 parts: 100 ÷ 5.
say.zh: 你把 100 分给了 4 条短线。4 条线分出 5 格：100 ÷ 5。

say.en: A small part is not always {u:1 g}. 100 shared between 5 parts is 20.
say.zh: 一小格不一定是 {u:1 g}。100 平均分成 5 格，每格 20。

fallback.en: Not yet. Divide 100 by the number of parts you tapped.
fallback.zh: 还没对。用 100 除以你点出的格数。

reveal.en: 200 − 100 = 100, and 100 ÷ 5 = 20. Each small part stands for {u:20 g}.

prompt.en: Siti weighs kangkong at the wet market. How heavy is it?
prompt.zh: Siti 在湿巴刹称空心菜。空心菜有多重？

guide.en: Find two numbered marks next to each other. Divide their difference by the number of parts, then count on to the needle.
guide.zh: 找出相邻的两个标了数的刻度，用两数之差除以格数，再数到指针。

hints.en: Look between 200 and 300.
There are 10 small parts. Each small part stands for {u:10 g}.
hints.zh: 中间有 10 小格。每一小格表示 {u:10 g}。

hints.en: The needle is 3 parts past 200.
hints.zh: 指针在 200 后面 3 格。

correct.en: Yes. The needle is 3 parts of {u:10 g} past 200, so the kangkong is {u:230 g}.
correct.zh: 对。指针在 200 后面 3 格，每格 {u:10 g}，所以空心菜是 {u:230 g}。

say.en: You added 1 for each part. Each small part stands for {u:10 g}. Count on from 200 in tens.
say.zh: 你每格只加了 1。每一小格表示 {u:10 g}。从 200 起，十个十个地数。

say.en: You counted one extra mark. From 200 to the needle there are 3 parts. Count the parts, not the marks.
say.zh: 你多算了一条刻度线。从 200 到指针有 3 格。数格子，不数刻度线。

say.en: You chose kilograms. Look at the unit on this dial: it is grams.
say.zh: 你选了千克。看清这台秤的单位：是克。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the size of a small part between 200 and 300, then count to the needle.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先找出 200 和 300 之间每一小格表示多少，再数到指针。

reveal.en: 100 ÷ 10 = 10. The reading is 200 + 3 × 10 = 230, so the kangkong is {u:230 g}.

prompt.en: How heavy are the prawns on Wei Jie’s scale?
prompt.zh: Wei Jie 的秤上这些虾有多重？

guide.en: Count the parts between two numbered marks. Use their size to count on from the number just before the needle.
guide.zh: 数一数两个标了数的刻度之间有几格。找出每格表示多少，再从指针前面的标数往后数。

hints.en: Look at the marks from 300 to 400.
hints.zh: 看 300 到 400 的刻度。

hints.en: 100 ÷ 5 = 20. Each small part stands for {u:20 g}.
Count 3 parts after 300: 320, 340, then the needle.
hints.zh: 从 300 往后数 3 格：320、340，接着就是指针。

correct.en: Yes. Each small part stands for {u:20 g}. Three parts past 300 is {u:360 g}.
correct.zh: 对。每一小格表示 {u:20 g}。300 后面 3 格是 {u:360 g}。

say.en: You treated each part as {u:1 g}. Each small part stands for {u:20 g}. Count on from 300 in twenties.
say.zh: 你把每格当成了 {u:1 g}。每一小格表示 {u:20 g}。从 300 起，二十二十地数。

say.en: You went one part past the needle. There are 3 parts after 300, not 4. Count the parts, not the marks.
say.zh: 你比指针多走了一格。300 后面是 3 格，不是 4 格。数格子，不数刻度线。

say.en: The number matches, but you chose kilograms. Read the grams unit on the dial.
say.zh: 数读对了，可是你选了千克。看秤上的单位，是克。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the 5 parts between 300 and 400, then count to the needle.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看 300 和 400 之间的 5 格，再数到指针。

reveal.en: Each small part stands for {u:20 g}. 300 + 3 × 20 = 360, so the prawns are {u:360 g}.

prompt.en: Read the wet-market scale. How heavy is the fish?
prompt.zh: 读湿巴刹这台秤。鱼有多重？

guide.en: The numbered marks go up by 200. Count the parts between them before reading the needle and choosing a unit.
guide.zh: 标数每次增加 200。先数两个标了数的刻度之间的格数，再读指针，选单位。

hints.en: Find the numbered marks on either side of the needle.
hints.zh: 找出指针两边的标了数的刻度。

hints.en: From 600 to 800 there are 2 parts. Each small part stands for {u:100 g}.
hints.zh: 600 到 800 有 2 格。每一小格表示 {u:100 g}。

hints.en: The needle is one part past 600.
hints.zh: 指针在 600 后面 1 格。

correct.en: Yes. 200 ÷ 2 = 100, so one part past 600 is {u:700 g}.

say.en: You added 1 for a part. The gap from 600 to 800 is split into 2 parts, each {u:100 g}.
say.zh: 你把一格当成了 1。600 到 800 分成 2 格，每格 {u:100 g}。

say.en: You counted the 600 mark as a part too. The needle is only one part after 600. Count the parts, not the marks.
say.zh: 你把 600 那条线也算成一格。指针只在 600 后面 1 格。数格子，不数刻度线。

say.en: You chose kilograms. The dial’s unit is grams; read the unit beside the scale.
say.zh: 你选了千克。秤的单位是克；看清秤上的单位。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find what the 2 parts from 600 to 800 stand for, then read the needle.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先找出 600 到 800 的 2 格每格表示多少，再读指针。

prompt.en: Siti uses a bigger scale for these fish. How heavy are they?
prompt.zh: Siti 用大一点的秤称这些鱼。鱼有多重？

guide.en: Read the unit on this dial. Find what each part stands for, then count from the numbered mark before the needle.
guide.zh: 看清秤的单位。找出每一小格表示多少，再从指针前面的标了数的刻度往后数。

hints.en: This dial is marked in kilograms.
hints.zh: 这台秤用千克作单位。

hints.en: There are 2 parts from 6 to 8. Each small part stands for {u:1 kg}.
hints.zh: 6 到 8 有 2 格。每一小格表示 {u:1 kg}。

hints.en: The needle is one part past 6.
hints.zh: 指针在 6 后面 1 格。

correct.en: Yes. One part of {u:1 kg} after 6 gives {u:7 kg}. You used the dial’s unit.
correct.zh: 对。6 后面 1 格，每格 {u:1 kg}，就是 {u:7 kg}。你选了秤上的单位。

say.en: You read the number but chose grams. Look at this dial: its unit is kilograms.
say.zh: 你读出了数，却选了克。看清这台秤：单位是千克。

say.en: You counted one part too many. The 6 mark is the starting mark. Count the parts, not the marks.
say.zh: 你多算了一格。6 那条线是起点。数格子，不数刻度线。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the unit and count the part from 6 to the needle.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看清单位，再数从 6 到指针的那一格。

reveal.en: 8 − 6 = 2, shared between 2 parts, so each part is {u:1 kg}. 6 + 1 = 7: the fish are {u:7 kg}.

prompt.en: Tap each small part from 200 to 300. What does each small part stand for?
prompt.zh: 点出 200 到 300 的每一小格。每一小格表示多少？

guide.en: Count the parts, not the marks. Share the difference between the two numbered marks equally between the parts.
guide.zh: 数格子，不数刻度线。把两个标了数的两个数之差平均分给这些格子。

hints.en: Look at the short mark between 200 and 300.
hints.zh: 看 200 和 300 中间的短刻度线。

hints.en: One short mark splits the gap into 2 parts.
hints.zh: 一条短刻度线把中间分成 2 格。

correct.en: Yes. The one short mark makes 2 parts. 100 ÷ 2 = 50, so each small part stands for {u:50 g}.
correct.zh: 对。一条短刻度线分出 2 格。100 ÷ 2 = 50，所以每一小格表示 {u:50 g}。

say.en: You divided by the one short mark. It makes 2 parts. Count the parts, not the marks.
say.zh: 你用 100 除以那一条短线。它分出 2 格。数格子，不数刻度线。

say.en: You treated the gap as 10 parts. Look between 200 and 300: there are only 2 parts.
say.zh: 你把中间当成了 10 格。看 200 和 300 之间：只有 2 格。

fallback.en: Not yet. Tap both spaces between 200 and 300, then share 100 between them.
fallback.zh: 还没对。点出 200 到 300 的两个空格，再把 100 平均分给它们。

reveal.en: The gap is {u:100 g}, split into 2 parts. Each small part stands for {u:50 g}.
reveal.zh: 中间相差 {u:100 g}，分成 2 格。每一小格表示 {u:50 g}。

prompt.en: Help Wei Jie load rice until the scale shows {u:450 g}.
prompt.zh: 帮 Wei Jie 加米，直到秤指着 {u:450 g}。

guide.en: Check that the needle starts at 0. Find what each small part stands for, then add rice until you reach the target.
guide.zh: 先看指针是不是从 0 开始。找出每一小格表示多少，再加米到目标刻度。

hints.en: Look at the short mark between 400 and 500.
hints.zh: 看 400 和 500 中间的短刻度线。

hints.en: Each small part stands for {u:50 g}.
hints.zh: 每一小格表示 {u:50 g}。

hints.en: Go to 400, then add one more small part.
hints.zh: 先到 400，再加一小格。

correct.en: Yes. You added one part of {u:50 g} after 400, so the rice is {u:450 g}.
correct.zh: 对。你从 400 再加了一格，每格 {u:50 g}，所以米是 {u:450 g}。

say.en: You stopped one part early by counting the starting mark. Count the parts, not the marks. Add one part after 400.
say.zh: 你把起点的刻度线也算了，少走了一格。数格子，不数刻度线。从 400 再加一格。

say.en: You moved 5 parts after 400 as if each were {u:10 g}. Each small part stands for {u:50 g}; use one part after 400.
say.zh: 你从 400 走了 5 格，把每格当成 {u:10 g}。每一小格表示 {u:50 g}；从 400 只需走一格。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look between 400 and 500. The target is halfway between them.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看 400 和 500 之间。目标在它们正中间。

reveal.en: Each small part stands for {u:50 g}. 400 + 50 = 450, so put the needle one part past 400.
reveal.zh: 每一小格表示 {u:50 g}。400 + 50 = 450，所以把指针移到 400 后面一格。

prompt.en: Load rice for Siti until the scale shows {u:160 g}.
prompt.zh: 帮 Siti 加米，直到秤指着 {u:160 g}。

guide.en: Find how many parts make the gap between two numbered marks. Use their size to move the needle to the target.
guide.zh: 找出两个标了数的刻度之间有几格。算出每格表示多少，再把指针移到目标。

hints.en: Look at the 5 parts from 100 to 200.
Each small part stands for {u:20 g}.
hints.zh: 每一小格表示 {u:20 g}。

hints.en: From 100, count 120, 140, then one more part.

correct.en: Yes. You moved 3 parts of {u:20 g} past 100: 100 + 60 = {u:160 g}.

say.en: You counted the 100 mark as the first part and stopped at 140. Count the parts, not the marks. Add one more part.
say.zh: 你把 100 那条线当成第一格，停在了 140。数格子，不数刻度线。再加一格。

say.en: You moved 6 parts after 100 as if each were {u:10 g}. Each small part stands for {u:20 g}; count 3 parts after 100.
say.zh: 你从 100 走了 6 格，把每格当成 {u:10 g}。每一小格表示 {u:20 g}；从 100 数 3 格。

fallback.en: Not yet. Start at the 100 mark and count the spaces in twenties.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从 100 那条刻度线起，二十二十地数空格。

reveal.en: 100 + 3 × 20 = 160. Put the needle 3 small parts after 100 to show {u:160 g}.

prompt.en: Which dial shows {u:350 g}?
prompt.zh: 哪一台秤指着 {u:350 g}？

guide.en: All four dials have the same marks. Find what each small part stands for, then look for the needle at the target.
guide.zh: 四台秤的刻度相同。找出每一小格表示多少，再找指着目标刻度的指针。

hints.en: Look between 300 and 400 on each dial.
hints.zh: 看每台秤的 300 和 400 之间。

hints.en: Each small part stands for {u:50 g}.
hints.zh: 每一小格表示 {u:50 g}。

hints.en: The target is one small part after 300.
hints.zh: 目标在 300 后面一小格。

correct.en: Yes. That needle is one part of {u:50 g} after 300: {u:350 g}.
correct.zh: 对。那根指针在 300 后面一格，每格 {u:50 g}：就是 {u:350 g}。

say.en: Counting marks can leave you one part away. Count the parts, not the marks. Look for one part after 300.
say.zh: 数刻度线会让你多算或少算一格。数格子，不数刻度线。找 300 后面一格。

say.en: You used 5 parts after 300 as if each were {u:10 g}. Each small part stands for {u:50 g}; use just one part.
say.zh: 你把每格当成 {u:10 g}，从 300 数了 5 格。每一小格表示 {u:50 g}；只需走一格。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the needle halfway between 300 and 400.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找在 300 和 400 正中间的指针。

reveal.en: 400 − 300 = 100, split into 2 parts of {u:50 g}. Dial C shows 300 + 50 = {u:350 g}.

caption.en: A tall, thin bottle and a short, wide bowl are both full of water. The bottle looks as if it holds more because it is taller. Looking is not enough.
caption.zh: 一个又高又细的瓶子，一个又矮又宽的碗，都装满了水。瓶子高，看起来装得多。光看是不够的。

caption.en: Pour each into the same kind of jug. The water from the bowl comes up to the 5th mark; the water from the bottle only to the 3rd. The bowl held more.
caption.zh: 把两边的水各倒进一样的量杯。碗里的水升到第 5 条线，瓶子里的只到第 3 条。碗装得多。

caption.en: The litre is a unit of volume. We write ℓ for litre. Aisha pours three {u:1 l} cartons of water into a big measuring jug. It comes up to {u:3 l}.
caption.zh: 升是容量的单位，写作 ℓ。Aisha 把 3 盒 {u:1 l} 的水倒进一个大量杯，水升到 {u:3 l}。

caption.en: Read the level from the side, with your eyes level with the top of the water. The numbers go up in twos, so each small part stands for {u:1 l}. There is {u:7 l} of water.
caption.zh: 读水位要从侧面看，眼睛和水面一样高。数一次跳 2，每一小格表示 {u:1 l}。桶里有 {u:7 l} 水。

keyFacts.en: To compare volumes, pour into the same kind of container.
keyFacts.zh: 比容量，要倒进一样的容器里比。

keyFacts.en: A taller container does not always hold more.
keyFacts.zh: 高的容器不一定装得多。

keyFacts.en: Read the level from the side, with your eyes level with the water.
keyFacts.zh: 从侧面读，眼睛和水面一样高。

prompt.en: How much water is in the pail?
prompt.zh: 桶里有多少水？

guide.en: Only 0 and 10 have numbers. Find what each small part stands for, then count up from 0.
guide.zh: 只有 0 和 10 标了数。先找出每一小格表示多少，再从 0 往上数。

hints.en: How many small parts are there from 0 to 10?
hints.zh: 从 0 到 10 有几小格？

hints.en: 10 ÷ 5 = 2: each small part stands for {u:2 l}.
hints.zh: 10 ÷ 5 = 2：每一小格表示 {u:2 l}。

hints.en: The water is 3 parts up: 2, 4, 6.

correct.en: Yes. Each small part is {u:2 l}, and the water is 3 parts up: {u:6 l}.
correct.zh: 对。每一小格是 {u:2 l}，水在第 3 格：{u:6 l}。

say.en: Each small part stands for {u:2 l}, not {u:1 l}: 5 parts make 10. Count up in twos.
say.zh: 每一小格表示 {u:2 l}，不是 {u:1 l}：5 格才是 10。两个两个地往上数。

say.en: You counted one part too many. The water is 3 parts above 0, not 4.
say.zh: 你多数了一格。水在 0 上面 3 格，不是 4 格。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find what each small part stands for, then count up from 0.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先找出每一小格表示多少，再从 0 往上数。

reveal.en: 5 parts make 10, so each is {u:2 l}. 3 parts up is 3 × 2 = 6: there is {u:6 l}.

prompt.en: Water from a tall vase and from a pot was poured into the same kind of jug. Which held more?
prompt.zh: 把高花瓶和锅里的水倒进一样的量杯。哪个装得多？

guide.en: The jugs are the same, so the higher level shows more water.
guide.zh: 量杯一样，水位高的水就多。

hints.en: Read each jug.
hints.zh: 读一读两个量杯。

hints.en: Which water came up higher?
hints.zh: 哪边的水升得更高？

correct.en: Yes. The pot's water came up to {u:4 l}, the vase's to {u:2 l}. The pot held more.
correct.zh: 对。锅里的水升到 {u:4 l}，花瓶里的只到 {u:2 l}。锅装得多。

say.en: The vase is taller, but in the same kind of jug its water came up only to {u:2 l}. The pot held more.
say.zh: 花瓶是高，可是倒进一样的量杯，它的水只到 {u:2 l}。锅装得多。

fallback.en: Not yet. Compare the two levels in the jugs, not the shapes.
fallback.zh: 还没对。比两个量杯里的水位，不比容器的样子。

reveal.en: {u:4 l} is more than {u:2 l}: the pot held more water than the tall vase.
reveal.zh: {u:4 l} 比 {u:2 l} 多：锅比高花瓶装的水多。

text.en: the vase, because it is taller

prompt.en: Water from a tall bottle and a low bowl is in matching jugs. Which container held more?
prompt.zh: 高瓶子和矮碗里的水倒进了一样的量杯。哪个容器装得多？

guide.en: The water has been poured into the same kind of jug. Compare the water levels to find which held more.
guide.zh: 水已经倒进一样的量杯。比一比水位，看看哪个装得多。

hints.en: Look at the water level in each jug.
hints.zh: 看看两个量杯里的水位。

hints.en: In matching jugs, the higher water level means more water.
hints.zh: 量杯一样，水位高的水就多。

correct.en: Yes. The bowl held {u:3 l} and the bottle held {u:1 l}. The bowl held more water.
correct.zh: 对。碗装了 {u:3 l}，瓶子装了 {u:1 l}。碗装的水更多。

say.en: The bottle is taller, but its water only reaches {u:1 l} in the matching jug. Compare this with the bowl’s {u:3 l}.
say.zh: 瓶子更高，可是它的水倒进一样的量杯只到 {u:1 l}。再看看碗里的 {u:3 l}。

fallback.en: Not yet. Compare the water levels in the matching jugs.
fallback.zh: 还没对。比一比两个一样的量杯里的水位。

reveal.en: {u:3 l} is more than {u:1 l}. The low bowl held more water than the tall bottle.
reveal.zh: {u:3 l} 比 {u:1 l} 多。矮碗比高瓶子装的水多。

text.en: The bottle, because it is taller

prompt.en: Aisha pours water from a low pail and a tall bottle into matching jugs. Which held more?
prompt.zh: Aisha 把矮桶和高瓶子里的水倒进一样的量杯。哪个装得多？

guide.en: Compare the levels after pouring into the same kind of jug. The original containers have different shapes.
guide.zh: 水倒进一样的量杯后，再比水位。原来的两个容器形状不同。

hints.en: Follow each label to see where the water came from.
hints.zh: 看量杯的标签，认清水是从哪里倒来的。

hints.en: Read both levels in litres, then compare the numbers.
hints.zh: 读出两边各有多少升，再比数。

correct.en: Yes. The pail’s water reaches {u:8 l} and the bottle’s reaches {u:5 l}. The pail held more.
correct.zh: 对。桶里的水到 {u:8 l}，瓶子里的水到 {u:5 l}。桶装得多。

say.en: Height alone does not tell you how much a container holds. In the matching jugs, the bottle’s water is lower than the pail’s.
say.zh: 光看高矮不能知道装了多少水。看看一样的量杯：瓶子里的水位比桶里的低。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the two water levels after pouring.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看倒进量杯后的两个水位。

reveal.en: {u:8 l} is more than {u:5 l}, so the low pail held more than the tall bottle.
reveal.zh: {u:8 l} 比 {u:5 l} 多，所以矮桶比高瓶子装得多。

text.en: The bottle, because it is taller

prompt.en: How much water is in Aisha’s measuring jug?
prompt.zh: Aisha 的量杯里有多少水？

guide.en: Read from the side with your eyes level with the water. Find the numbered mark below the water, then count up in small parts.
guide.zh: 从侧面看，眼睛和水面一样高。找到水面下面标了数的刻度，再往上数小格。

hints.en: Look between 4 and 6 on the scale.
hints.zh: 看看刻度上的 4 和 6 之间。

hints.en: Each small part stands for {u:1 l}.
hints.zh: 每一小格表示 {u:1 l}。

hints.en: The water is one small part above 4.
hints.zh: 水面在 4 上面一小格。

correct.en: Yes. The water is one part of {u:1 l} above 4: there is {u:5 l}.
correct.zh: 对。水面在 4 上面一格，每格 {u:1 l}：有 {u:5 l}。

say.en: You counted one part too many. From 4 to the water there is one part. Count the parts, not the marks.
say.zh: 你多数了一格。从 4 到水面只有一格。数格子，不数刻度线。

fallback.en: Not yet. Start at the mark 4 and count the small parts up to the water.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从刻度 4 开始，往上数到水面。

reveal.en: 4 + 1 = 5. Each small part stands for {u:1 l}, so the jug has {u:5 l} of water.
reveal.zh: 4 + 1 = 5。每一小格表示 {u:1 l}，所以量杯里有 {u:5 l} 水。

prompt.en: Read the scale. How much water is in the pail?
prompt.zh: 读一读刻度。桶里有多少水？

guide.en: Find how many small parts make the gap between the numbered marks. Work out each part before counting to the water.
guide.zh: 先数出两个标了数的刻度之间有几小格。算出每格表示多少，再数到水面。

hints.en: There are 5 small parts from 0 to 10.
hints.zh: 从 0 到 10 有 5 小格。

hints.en: 10 ÷ 5 = 2. Each small part stands for {u:2 l}.
hints.zh: 10 ÷ 5 = 2。每一小格表示 {u:2 l}。

hints.en: The water is 4 small parts above 0.
hints.zh: 水面在 0 上面 4 小格。

correct.en: Yes. Four parts of {u:2 l} make {u:8 l}.
correct.zh: 对。4 小格，每格 {u:2 l}，一共是 {u:8 l}。

say.en: You counted each part as {u:1 l}. Each small part stands for {u:2 l}. Count up in twos from 0.
say.zh: 你把每格当成了 {u:1 l}。每一小格表示 {u:2 l}。从 0 起两个两个地往上数。

say.en: You counted one part too many. The water is 4 parts above 0, not 5. Count the parts, not the marks.
say.zh: 你多数了一格。水面在 0 上面 4 格，不是 5 格。数格子，不数刻度线。

fallback.en: Not yet. Divide 10 by the 5 parts, then count up to the water.
fallback.zh: 还没对。用 10 除以 5 格，再往上数到水面。

reveal.en: 10 ÷ 5 = 2, and 4 × 2 = 8. The pail contains {u:8 l} of water.

prompt.en: How many litres of water can you read in this measuring jug?
prompt.zh: 这个量杯里有多少升水？

guide.en: Use the numbers at the ends of the scale. Share the gap equally between the small parts, then read the water level.
guide.zh: 看看刻度两端的数。把两数的差平均分给这些小格，再读水位。

hints.en: From 0 to 6 there are 3 small parts.
hints.zh: 从 0 到 6 有 3 小格。

hints.en: 6 ÷ 3 = 2. Each small part stands for {u:2 l}.
hints.zh: 6 ÷ 3 = 2。每一小格表示 {u:2 l}。

hints.en: The water is at the first mark above 0.
hints.zh: 水面在 0 上面的第一条刻度线。

correct.en: Yes. The water is one part above 0, and each part is {u:2 l}. There is {u:2 l} of water.
correct.zh: 对。水面在 0 上面一格，每格 {u:2 l}。量杯里有 {u:2 l} 水。
